sentences.zh: 劉錫祺，字佩之，直隸天津人。

translations.literal: Liu Xiqi, style name Peizhi, was a native of Tianjin in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiqi, whose style was Peizhi, came from Tianjin in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 畢業將弁學堂。

translations.literal: He graduated from the Officers' Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He graduated from the officers' academy.

sentences.zh: 第八鎮成立，為正參謀官。

translations.literal: When the Eighth Division was formed, he served as senior staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: When the Eighth Division was established, he became its senior staff officer.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十二年，南、北陸軍於河間會操，籌度有勞，加正參領銜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Guangxu, when the northern and southern armies held joint maneuvers at Hejian, he was rewarded for his planning efforts with the brevet rank of senior staff colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Guangxu, after the northern and southern armies held joint maneuvers at Hejian, he was commended for his planning work and given the brevet rank of senior staff colonel.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年夏秋間，革命黨人之在武漢者數被破獲，總督瑞澂恣意捕殺，人人危懼。

translations.literal: In the summer and autumn of the third year of Xuantong, revolutionaries in Wuhan were repeatedly uncovered, and Governor Rui Cheng arrested and killed at will, so that everyone lived in fear.
translations.idiomatic: During the summer and autumn of the third year of Xuantong, revolutionaries in Wuhan were uncovered again and again, and Governor Rui Cheng arrested and killed people at will until everyone lived in fear.

sentences.zh: 八月十九日，武昌變作，始僅工程營數十人，他軍無應者。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth day of the eighth month the uprising broke out at Wuchang; at first only several dozen men of the engineering battalion rose, and no other units responded.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth day of the eighth month the Wuchang mutiny began with only several dozen men from the engineering battalion, and no other units joined them at first.

sentences.zh: 瑞澂遽逃兵監，省垣無主。

translations.literal: Rui Cheng fled in haste to the naval yard, and the provincial capital was left without a leader.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Cheng fled in haste to the naval yard, leaving the provincial capital without a leader.

sentences.zh: 於是各營皆起，擁立都督黎元洪，稱軍政府，獨立。

translations.literal: Thereupon every battalion rose, installed Li Yuanhong as military governor, proclaimed a military government, and declared independence.
translations.idiomatic: Then every battalion rose, installed Li Yuanhong as military governor, proclaimed a military government, and declared independence.

sentences.zh: 錫祺時方赴沙市，以二十六日回武昌，各營爭往迎謁，趣入見元洪，錫祺正色曰：「國家歲糜巨帑練兵，原期君等為國干城，以禦外侮。

translations.literal: Xiqi was then on his way to Shashi and returned to Wuchang on the twenty-sixth; the various battalions vied to welcome him and urged him to go in and see Yuanhong. Xiqi said sternly, "The state spends vast sums each year to train troops, expecting you to be bulwarks of the realm and ward off foreign aggression.
translations.idiomatic: Xiqi was then traveling to Shashi and returned to Wuchang on the twenty-sixth. The battalions vied to welcome him and pressed him to go in and see Yuanhong. Xiqi said sternly, "The state spends vast sums every year to train soldiers, expecting you to be bulwarks of the realm against foreign aggression.

sentences.zh: 奈何一旦為人煽惑，遽爾發難乎？

translations.literal: How can you, stirred up in a moment, rashly rise in revolt?
translations.idiomatic: How can you let yourselves be stirred up and rise in revolt so rashly?

sentences.zh: 禍機一動，將無已時！

translations.literal: Once disaster is set in motion, it will know no end!
translations.idiomatic: Once disaster is set in motion, there will be no end to it!

sentences.zh: 吾不能為君等所為。

translations.literal: I cannot do what you are doing.
translations.idiomatic: I cannot do what you are doing.

sentences.zh: 」眾聞之譁怒，即於坐中擊殺之。

translations.literal: " The crowd, hearing this, erupted in outrage and killed him on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: " The crowd erupted in outrage at his words and killed him where he sat.

sentences.zh: 事聞，照協都統例從優賜卹。

translations.literal: When word of the affair reached the court, he was granted posthumous favors according to the precedent for a deputy commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: When the court learned of the affair, he was granted generous posthumous honors according to the precedent for a deputy commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 發難時，​​督隊官阮榮發出阻，眾遽擊斃之。

translations.literal: At the outbreak of the revolt, the battalion commander Ruan Rongfa came out to stop them, and the crowd promptly shot him dead.
translations.idiomatic: When the revolt broke out, battalion commander Ruan Rongfa came out to stop them, and the crowd shot him dead on the spot.

sentences.zh: 榮發邑裡未詳。

translations.literal: Rongfa's native place is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Rongfa's native place is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 程彬，字筱竹，江西樂安人。

translations.literal: Cheng Bin, style name Xiaozhu, was a native of Le'an in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Bin, whose style was Xiaozhu, came from Le'an in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 時署鮎魚司巡檢。

translations.literal: At the time he was acting sub-prefect of Nianyusi.
translations.idiomatic: At the time he was serving as acting sub-prefect of Nianyusi.

sentences.zh: 署在省城南，十九夜見城外火起，彬馳往救護，至望山門外正街，突遇陸軍砲隊入城，皆袖纏白布，彬大駭，厲聲問曰：「汝等反耶！

translations.literal: His post lay south of the provincial capital. On the night of the nineteenth he saw fires outside the walls and rushed out to help; on the main street outside Wangshan Gate he suddenly met the army artillery entering the city, all with white cloth bound on their sleeves. Bin was greatly alarmed and shouted, "Are you rebelling?
translations.idiomatic: His post lay south of the provincial capital. On the night of the nineteenth he saw fires outside the walls and rushed out to help. On the main street outside Wangshan Gate he suddenly met army artillery entering the city with white cloth bound on their sleeves. Bin was greatly alarmed and shouted, "Are you rebelling?

sentences.zh: 此何為者？

translations.literal: What is the meaning of this?
translations.idiomatic: What is the meaning of this?

sentences.zh: 」眾舉槍擬之，彬益前致詰，遂遇害。

translations.literal: " The crowd raised their guns at him, but Bin pressed forward still more to question them, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: " The crowd leveled their guns at him, but Bin pressed forward to question them all the more and was killed.

sentences.zh: 以一巡檢犯難而死，人皆哀而壯之。

translations.literal: That a mere sub-prefect should die facing peril moved everyone to mourn him and admire his courage.
translations.idiomatic: That a mere sub-prefect should die facing peril moved everyone to mourn him and admire his courage.

sentences.zh: 桂廕，字輯五，姓嵩佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗文生。

translations.literal: Gui Yin, style name Jiwu, surname Songjia, was a licentiate of the Bordered Blue Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Yin, whose style was Jiwu and whose clan name was Songjia, was a licentiate of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 由刑部郎中、軍機章京外擢施南府知府，調安陸，以治堤盡力名。

translations.literal: From director in the Ministry of Punishments and clerk in the Grand Council he was promoted outside the capital to prefect of Shinan Prefecture, then transferred to Anlu, where he won renown for his devoted work on the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: After serving as a director in the Ministry of Punishments and as a clerk in the Grand Council, he was promoted to prefect of Shinan Prefecture and later transferred to Anlu, where he won renown for his devoted work on the dikes.

sentences.zh: 安陸為襄樊門戶，府城故無兵。

translations.literal: Anlu was the gateway to Xiang and Fan, and the prefectural city had no troops of its own.
translations.idiomatic: Anlu was the gateway to Xiangyang and Fancheng, and the prefectural seat had no troops of its own.

sentences.zh: 武昌變聞，圖守計，並牒道請兵，已而旁郡德安、荊州皆陷。

translations.literal: When word came of the Wuchang uprising, he planned how to hold the city and memorialized the circuit intendant to request troops; soon afterward the neighboring prefectures De'an and Jingzhou both fell.
translations.idiomatic: When word came of the Wuchang uprising, he drew up plans to defend the city and petitioned the circuit intendant for troops, but soon the neighboring prefectures of De'an and Jingzhou had both fallen.

sentences.zh: 十月初五日，鄖陽兵驟變，圍府署，劫印信。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the tenth month the troops at Yunyang mutinied suddenly, surrounded the prefectural yamen, and seized the official seals.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the tenth month the troops at Yunyang mutinied, surrounded the prefectural yamen, and seized the official seals.

sentences.zh: 桂廕攜妻富察氏趨入文廟，夫婦同縊崇聖殿中，死，衣帶中書有「虛生一世，不能報國安民」數語。

translations.literal: Gui Yin took his wife, née Fucha, and hurried into the Confucian temple; husband and wife hanged themselves together in the Hall of Sage Worship and died. In his belt were written the words, "I have lived my life in vain and could not repay the state or bring peace to the people."
translations.idiomatic: Gui Yin took his wife, née Fucha, and hurried into the Confucian temple, where husband and wife hanged themselves together in the Hall of Sage Worship. In his belt were written the words, "I have lived my life in vain and could not repay the state or bring peace to the people."

sentences.zh: 臨殉難時，顧謂僕曰：「葬我必北面！

translations.literal: As he faced death he turned to his servant and said, "When you bury me, you must lay me facing north!
translations.idiomatic: As he faced death he turned to his servant and said, "When you bury me, lay me facing north!

sentences.zh: 」官紳流涕斂之，葬城內陽春台側。

translations.literal: " The officials and gentry, weeping, laid out his body and buried him beside Yangchun Terrace inside the city.
translations.idiomatic: " The officials and gentry laid out his body in tears and buried him beside Yangchun Terrace inside the city.

sentences.zh: 存厚，字寬甫，正白旗監生。

translations.literal: Cunhou, style name Kuanfu, was a student of the Imperial Household from the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Cunhou, whose style was Kuanfu, was a student of the Imperial Household from the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 由內務府郎中選宜昌府，調辦襄陽榷局。

translations.literal: From director in the Imperial Household he was selected for Yichang Prefecture, then transferred to manage the Xiangyang transit-tax bureau.
translations.idiomatic: After serving as a director in the Imperial Household, he was selected for Yichang Prefecture and later transferred to manage the Xiangyang transit-tax bureau.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年十月，郡中黨人應武昌，存厚揮家人出避，曰：「吾嗣不絕，死無憾！

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Xuantong, local revolutionaries in the prefecture responded to Wuchang. Cunhou sent his family away to safety and said, "My line will not die out; I have no regret in dying!
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of Xuantong, local revolutionaries in the prefecture rose in response to Wuchang. Cunhou sent his family away to safety and said, "My line will not die out, and I have no regret in dying!

sentences.zh: 」局丁旋縶存厚，擁至北門校場戕之，幼子被搜獲，驚死。

translations.literal: " The bureau runners soon seized Cunhou, dragged him to the drill ground at the north gate, and killed him. His young son was found in the search and died of fright.
translations.idiomatic: " The bureau runners soon seized him, dragged him to the drill ground at the north gate, and killed him. His young son was found in the search and died of fright.

sentences.zh: 榮濬，字心川，荊州駐防，蒙古鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Rong Jun, style name Xinchuan, was a garrison bannerman at Jingzhou, a Mongol of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Jun, whose style was Xinchuan, was a Mongol of the Bordered Blue Banner stationed at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年進士，用知縣，發湖北，補天門縣。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the thirtieth year of Guangxu, he was appointed magistrate and sent to Hubei, where he was assigned to Tianmen County.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the thirtieth year of Guangxu, was appointed magistrate, and was sent to Hubei, where he was assigned to Tianmen County.

sentences.zh: 操行不苟。

translations.literal: His conduct was scrupulous.
translations.idiomatic: His conduct was scrupulous.

sentences.zh: 變作後，荊防旗人有自武昌脫歸者，道天門，語狀，且為榮濬危。

translations.literal: After the uprising, a bannerman of the Jing-Fang garrison who had escaped from Wuchang passed through Tianmen, described what had happened, and warned that Rong Jun was in danger.
translations.idiomatic: After the uprising, a bannerman of the Jing-Fang garrison who had escaped from Wuchang passed through Tianmen, described what had happened, and warned that Rong Jun was in danger.

sentences.zh: 榮濬以死自誓，集紳耆、練民團為保衛計。

translations.literal: Rong Jun pledged himself to death, gathered the local gentry and elders, and drilled civilian militia for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Jun pledged himself to death, gathered the local gentry and elders, and drilled civilian militia for the city's defense.

sentences.zh: 無何，黨眾來攻，遂被害。

translations.literal: Before long the revolutionary forces came to attack, and he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the revolutionary forces attacked, and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 記名驍騎校炳安同死，僕成鬆亦殉焉。

translations.literal: The registered xiàoqí captain Bing'an died with him, and his servant Chengsong also perished in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The registered xiàoqí captain Bing'an died with him, and his servant Chengsong perished as well.

sentences.zh: 同時殉國難者，為候補縣丞錫楨，姓汪氏，漢軍人。

translations.literal: Those who died for the state at the same time included the expectant assistant magistrate Xizhen, surname Wang, a Han bannerman.
translations.idiomatic: Those who died for the state at the same time included the expectant assistant magistrate Xizhen, whose clan name was Wang and who was a Han bannerman.

sentences.zh: 充沙市警察官，盡室被殲。

translations.literal: He served as police officer at Shashi, and his entire household was wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: He served as police officer at Shashi, and his entire household was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 簰洲司巡檢方祖楨，安徽桐城人。

translations.literal: The sub-prefect of Paizhousi, Fang Zuzhen, was a native of Tongcheng in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zuzhen, sub-prefect of Paizhousi, came from Tongcheng in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 鄂軍頭目將入湘，道簰洲，土豪某夙銜祖楨，嗾人殺之江岸石花街。

translations.literal: A leader of the Hubei army was about to enter Hunan and passed Paizhou. A local bully who had long borne a grudge against Zuzhen incited men to kill him on Shihua Street by the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: A leader of the Hubei army was about to enter Hunan and passed through Paizhou. A local bully who had long borne a grudge against Zuzhen incited men to kill him on Shihua Street by the riverbank.

sentences.zh: 巡檢王萃奎，江西豐城人。

translations.literal: The sub-prefect Wang Cuikui was a native of Fengcheng in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Cuikui, a sub-prefect, came from Fengcheng in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 佐穀城縣，治盜有聲。

translations.literal: He assisted at Gucheng County and won renown for suppressing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He assisted at Gucheng County and won renown for suppressing bandits.

sentences.zh: 襄陽既變，屬邑響應，盜渠縶萃奎及一子、一孫殺之。

translations.literal: When Xiangyang rose in revolt, the subordinate counties followed suit, and bandit chiefs seized Cuikui along with one son and one grandson and killed them.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiangyang rose in revolt, the subordinate counties followed suit, and bandit chiefs seized Cuikui along with one son and one grandson and killed them.

sentences.zh: 蘄州吏目駱兆綸，字文卿，湖南江華人。

translations.literal: The Qizhou clerical officer Luo Zhaolun, style name Wenqing, was a native of Jianghua in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Zhaolun, clerical officer of Qizhou, whose style was Wenqing, came from Jianghua in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 亂作，知州亡去，州人以綸習吏事，遮留之。

translations.literal: When the turmoil broke out the prefect fled, and the people of the prefecture, knowing that Lun was versed in administrative affairs, blocked his way and detained him.
translations.idiomatic: When the turmoil broke out the prefect fled, and the people of the prefecture, knowing that Lun was versed in administrative affairs, blocked his way and detained him.

sentences.zh: 綸請送母至漢口乃還，至治所，以全省皆陷，事無可為，憤絕投河死。

translations.literal: Lun asked leave to escort his mother to Hankou and then return. When he reached his post and saw that the whole province had fallen and nothing could be done, he drowned himself in the river in despair.
translations.idiomatic: Lun asked leave to escort his mother to Hankou and then return. When he reached his post and saw that the whole province had fallen and nothing could be done, he drowned himself in the river in despair.

sentences.zh: 又襄陽府某縣典史，當變作時，晨起跽廨門外，過者叩頭要入，得負販者十八人。

translations.literal: There was also a certain archivist of a county in Xiangyang Prefecture who, when the uprising broke out, rose early and knelt outside the yamen gate; he bowed to passersby and begged them to enter, and gathered eighteen porters and peddlers.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a certain county archivist in Xiangyang Prefecture who, when the uprising broke out, rose early and knelt outside the yamen gate, bowing to passersby until he gathered eighteen porters and peddlers.

sentences.zh: 出銀幣二百枚分遺之，曰：「平生所積止此！

translations.literal: He took out two hundred silver coins and distributed them, saying, "All I have saved in my life is this!
translations.idiomatic: He took out two hundred silver coins and gave them away, saying, "This is all I have saved in my life!

sentences.zh: 城破義不得活，請助我殺敵。

translations.literal: When the city falls, righteousness will not let me live; please help me kill the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When the city falls I cannot live with honor; please help me fight the enemy.

sentences.zh: 」眾感其義，各攜肩輿長木及負擔之具，噪而出。

translations.literal: " Moved by his righteousness, each man took up a sedan pole, a long pole, or a carrying pole, and rushed out with a clamor.
translations.idiomatic: " Moved by his righteousness, they each seized sedan poles, long staves, or carrying poles and rushed out with a shout.

sentences.zh: 變軍方踞府署，出不意擊死者數人，俄而排槍起，某與十八人者皆死。

translations.literal: The revolutionary troops were just occupying the prefectural yamen; taken by surprise, several were killed, but soon volley fire opened, and the archivist and the eighteen men all died.
translations.idiomatic: The revolutionary troops were occupying the prefectural yamen; taken by surprise they lost several men, but soon volley fire opened and the archivist and all eighteen men were killed.

sentences.zh: 候補知府張曾疇，字望屺，江蘇無錫人。

translations.literal: The expectant prefect Zhang Cengchou, style name Wangqi, was a native of Wuxi in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cengchou, an expectant prefect whose style was Wangqi, came from Wuxi in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 以書跡似總督張之洞，為之洞所賞，充文案有年，榷漢陽車站貨捐。

translations.literal: Because his handwriting resembled that of Governor-General Zhang Zhidong, he was favored by Zhang and served for years as a clerk, later collecting the commodity tax at the Hanyang railway station.
translations.idiomatic: Because his handwriting resembled Governor-General Zhang Zhidong's, Zhang favored him and kept him as a clerk for years before assigning him to collect the commodity tax at the Hanyang railway station.

sentences.zh: 戰事起，避上海，仇者誣為挾貲遁，脅還漢口，會計出入悉符合，得還。

translations.literal: When fighting broke out he fled to Shanghai, but enemies accused him of absconding with funds and forced him back to Hankou; the accounts matched in every detail, and he was cleared to return.
translations.idiomatic: When fighting broke out he fled to Shanghai, but enemies accused him of absconding with public funds and forced him back to Hankou; when the accounts were checked they matched in every detail and he was cleared.

sentences.zh: 黨人適同舟，面辱之，捽其冠，遽投江死。

translations.literal: Revolutionaries happened to be on the same boat, insulted him to his face, tore off his hat, and he at once threw himself into the river and died.
translations.idiomatic: Revolutionaries happened to be on the same boat; they insulted him to his face, tore off his hat, and he at once threw himself into the river and died.

sentences.zh: 候補知縣聯森，字植三，蒙古鑲紅旗人，隸荊州駐防。

translations.literal: The expectant magistrate Liansen, style name Zhisān, was a Mongol of the Bordered Red Banner attached to the Jingzhou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Liansen, an expectant magistrate whose style was Zhisān, was a Mongol of the Bordered Red Banner attached to the Jingzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年舉人，挑知縣，發廣東，改湖北。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate of the eighth year of Guangxu, he was selected as magistrate, sent to Guangdong, and then transferred to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in the eighth year of Guangxu, was selected as magistrate, was first sent to Guangdong, and was later transferred to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 屢榷釐捐，能卹商。

translations.literal: He repeatedly collected the lijin transit tax and was able to show mercy to merchants.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly collected the lijin transit tax and treated merchants with consideration.

sentences.zh: 九月，道出漢陽，變兵爭索金，慷慨大罵，遇害。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he passed through Hanyang; mutinous soldiers clamored for money, and he denounced them boldly and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he passed through Hanyang; mutinous soldiers demanded money, and he denounced them boldly and was killed.

sentences.zh: 子寶焯、兄子寶明從死。

translations.literal: His son Baochao and his brother's son Baoming died with him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Baochao and his nephew Baoming died with him.

sentences.zh: 張景良，湖北人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jingliang was a native of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jingliang was a native of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 將弁學堂畢業生。

translations.literal: He was a graduate of the Officers' Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was a graduate of the officers' academy.

sentences.zh: 遊學日本歸，充湖北新軍標統。

translations.literal: After studying in Japan he returned and served as colonel of a regiment in the Hubei New Army.
translations.idiomatic: After studying in Japan he returned to serve as colonel of a regiment in the Hubei New Army.

sentences.zh: 武昌既擁立都督，景良慷慨說之曰：「朝廷已宣布立憲，不宜更言革命。

translations.literal: After Wuchang had installed a military governor, Jingliang spoke to him earnestly and said, "The court has already proclaimed constitutional government; one ought not speak of revolution again.
translations.idiomatic: After Wuchang had installed a military governor, Jingliang spoke to him earnestly: "The court has already proclaimed constitutional government; there is no need to speak of revolution again.

sentences.zh: 公受知遇久，諸將惟公命是聽，盍三思之？

translations.literal: You have long enjoyed imperial favor, and the generals will obey only your command—why not think thrice about this?
translations.idiomatic: You have long enjoyed imperial favor, and the generals will obey only your command—why not think again before you act?

sentences.zh: 」變軍怒，拘景良署中。

translations.literal: " The revolutionary troops were enraged and detained Jingliang in their headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: " The revolutionary troops were enraged and detained Jingliang at their headquarters.

sentences.zh: 時清兵攻漢陽，景良陽請赴前敵，以妻子為質，乃委充司令官。

translations.literal: At that time Qing troops were attacking Hanyang. Jingliang feigned a request to go to the front and offered his wife and children as hostages, whereupon he was appointed commander.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Qing troops were attacking Hanyang. Jingliang pretended to ask to go to the front and offered his wife and children as hostages, whereupon he was appointed commander.

sentences.zh: 九月初六日之戰，清兵卻，景良率砲隊出，臨發，砲予彈一枚，槍予彈一排，甫戰彈罄，景良遽大聲促軍退，眾不知所為，遂大潰，死者枕藉，清兵得進屯大智門。

translations.literal: In the battle of the sixth day of the ninth month the Qing army fell back. Jingliang led the artillery out; before firing he gave each gun one shell and each rifle one clip. They had scarcely begun to fight when the ammunition was spent. Jingliang suddenly shouted loudly for the army to retreat; the men did not know what to do and broke in rout, the dead lying piled one on another, and the Qing army was able to advance and encamp at Dazhi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the battle on the sixth day of the ninth month the Qing army fell back. Jingliang led the artillery out and, before firing, issued each gun one shell and each rifle one clip. They had scarcely begun fighting when the ammunition was gone. Jingliang suddenly shouted for a retreat; the men did not know what to do and broke in rout, the dead lying in heaps, and the Qing army advanced to encamp at Dazhi Gate.

sentences.zh: 後廉其故，殺景良，臨刑夷然，仰天大言曰：「某今日乃不負大清矣！

translations.literal: Later, when his treachery was learned, they killed Jingliang. At execution he was calm and declared to heaven, "Today I have not failed the Great Qing!
translations.idiomatic: Later, when his treachery was discovered, they executed Jingliang. At the block he was calm and cried to heaven, "Today I have not failed the Great Qing!

sentences.zh: 倭和布，字清泉，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Wo Hebu, style name Qingquan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wo Hebu, whose style was Qingquan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 家世以武功顯，獨兼肄文學。

translations.literal: His family had long been distinguished for martial achievement, and he alone also cultivated letters.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been distinguished for martial achievement, and he alone also cultivated letters.

sentences.zh: 起家護軍藍翎長，歷二等侍衛。

translations.literal: He began as a blue-tasseled corporal in the guards and rose to second-rank imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a blue-tasseled corporal in the guards and rose to second-rank imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 拳匪之變，歐人僑京者多被戕，倭和布護之甚至。

translations.literal: During the Boxer uprising many Europeans resident in the capital were killed, and Wo Hebu protected them with exceptional zeal.
translations.idiomatic: During the Boxer uprising many Europeans in the capital were killed, and Wo Hebu protected them with exceptional zeal.

sentences.zh: 或詰之，曰：「外人僑吾國，勝之不武。

translations.literal: When someone questioned him, he said, "Foreigners sojourn in our country; to overcome them would be unworthy.
translations.idiomatic: When someone questioned him, he said, "Foreigners live in our country as guests; to overcome them would be unworthy.

sentences.zh: 無故與八國構釁，敗將不國，吾敢重召亂乎？

translations.literal: To provoke the Eight Powers without cause—defeat will destroy the state. How dare I invite chaos again?
translations.idiomatic: To provoke the Eight Powers without cause will destroy the state in defeat. How dare I invite chaos again?

sentences.zh: 」旋扈駕西行，家人初以為戰死。

translations.literal: " He soon escorted the court westward, and at first his family thought he had died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: " He soon escorted the court westward, and at first his family thought he had died in battle.

sentences.zh: 出為湖北均光營參將，擢施南協副將。

translations.literal: He went out to Hubei as deputy commander of the Junguang Battalion and was promoted to deputy commander of the Shinan Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He went out to Hubei as deputy commander of the Junguang Battalion and was promoted to deputy commander of the Shinan Brigade.

sentences.zh: 川寇陷黔江，率所部赴援，獲其渠，斬以徇。

translations.literal: When Sichuan bandits took Qianjiang, he led his troops to the relief, captured their leader, and executed him as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: When Sichuan bandits took Qianjiang, he led his troops to relieve the city, captured their leader, and executed him as a warning.

sentences.zh: 武昌變作，鄂將屯宜昌者應之，倭和佈時以裁缺寓宜城，被執，勸降不應，以得死為幸，遂槍殺之。

translations.literal: When the Wuchang uprising broke out, the Hubei general stationed at Yichang responded. Wo Hebu was then living at Yicheng on reduced pay after being cut from the rolls; he was seized, refused when urged to surrender, counted death a blessing, and was shot.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wuchang uprising broke out, the Hubei general stationed at Yichang joined the revolt. Wo Hebu was then living at Yicheng on reduced pay after being cut from the rolls; he was seized, refused to surrender, welcomed death as a blessing, and was shot.

sentences.zh: 週飛鵬，字翔千，江西新建人。

translations.literal: Zhou Feipeng, style name Xiangqian, was a native of Xinjian in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Feipeng, whose style was Xiangqian, came from Xinjian in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 由武舉人累官都司，充湖北襄防馬隊管帶，駐老河口。

translations.literal: From military licentiate he rose through offices to colonel, served as commander of the Xiang-Fang cavalry detachment in Hubei, and was stationed at Laohekou.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a military licentiate, he rose to colonel and served as commander of the Xiang-Fang cavalry detachment in Hubei, stationed at Laohekou.

sentences.zh: 鄂軍變，縣無賴出獄囚，糾水師營謀變，飛鵬持不可，出佩刀與鬥。

translations.literal: When the Hubei army mutinied, local ruffians released prisoners and incited the naval battalion to plot rebellion. Feipeng held that this must not be done, drew his sword, and fought them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hubei army mutinied, local ruffians released prisoners and incited the naval battalion to rebel. Feipeng refused to allow it, drew his sword, and fought them.

sentences.zh: 槍及馬腹，墜馬，槍繼至，洞胸死。

translations.literal: A shot struck his horse's belly and he fell; more shots followed, one piercing his chest, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: A shot struck his horse's belly and he fell from the saddle; more shots followed, one piercing his chest, and he died.

sentences.zh: 裁缺荊州城守營參將玉萼，亦遇難死之。

translations.literal: Yu'e, a deputy commander of the Jingzhou garrison cut from the rolls, also died in the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Yu'e, a deputy commander of the Jingzhou garrison who had been cut from the rolls, also died in the calamity.

sentences.zh: 松興，蒙古正白旗人，荊州駐防。

translations.literal: Song Xing was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner, garrisoned at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Song Xing was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner stationed at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以諸生改武職，累官協領，記名副都統，充常備軍統領。

translations.literal: From licentiate he changed to a military career, rose to assistant commandant, was registered as deputy lieutenant general, and served as commander of the standing army.
translations.idiomatic: After changing from a licentiate to a military career, he rose to assistant commandant, was registered as deputy lieutenant general, and commanded the standing army.

sentences.zh: 變兵入城，被縶入鄂，叱使跪，曰：「吾朝廷大吏，城不保，義當死。

translations.literal: When mutinous troops entered the city he was seized and taken to Hubei, where they ordered him to kneel. He cried, "I am a high official of the court; if the city cannot be held, righteousness demands death.
translations.idiomatic: When mutinous troops entered the city he was seized and taken to Hubei, where they ordered him to kneel. He cried, "I am a high official of the court; if the city cannot be held, I am bound to die.

sentences.zh: 頭可斷，膝不可屈！

translations.literal: My head may be cut off, but my knees will not bend!
translations.idiomatic: My head may be cut off, but my knees will not bend!

sentences.zh: 」士紳三十餘人馳救之，已及於難。

translations.literal: " More than thirty gentry and officials rushed to save him, but disaster had already overtaken him.
translations.idiomatic: " More than thirty gentry and officials rushed to save him, but it was too late.

sentences.zh: 其戚善吉、庖人福全皆從死。

translations.literal: His kinsman Shanji and his cook Fuquan both died with him.
translations.idiomatic: His kinsman Shanji and his cook Fuquan both died with him.

sentences.zh: 駐防之同時殉難者，在武昌有兵備處提調松俊，守楚望台火藥庫，變兵攻庫，力戰死。

translations.literal: Among the garrison troops who died at the same time, at Wuchang was Song Jun, overseer of military supplies, who defended the gunpowder depot at Chuwangtai; mutineers attacked the depot and he died fighting fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: Among the garrison troops who died at the same time, in Wuchang Song Jun, overseer of military supplies, defended the gunpowder depot at Chuwangtai; when mutineers attacked the depot he fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 三十標隊官重光，守籓庫，變兵掠取庫儲，重光大呼：「保全名譽！

translations.literal: Chongguang, company officer of the Thirtieth Standard, guarded the princely treasury; mutineers looted the stores, and Chongguang cried aloud, "Preserve your honor!
translations.idiomatic: Chongguang, company officer of the Thirtieth Standard, guarded the princely treasury; when mutineers looted the stores he cried aloud, "Preserve your honor!

sentences.zh: 」被槍死。

translations.literal: " He was shot dead.
translations.idiomatic: He was shot dead.

sentences.zh: 妻趙，子春年、長年、寶年同日殉。

translations.literal: His wife Zhao and his sons Chunnian, Changnian, and Baonian all died with him the same day.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Zhao and his sons Chunnian, Changnian, and Baonian died with him the same day.

sentences.zh: 四十一標排長色德本，三十標副軍需官寶善，二十九標排長德齡、隊官東良、排長德培，均戰死。

translations.literal: Sedeben, platoon leader of the Forty-first Standard; Baoshan, assistant quartermaster of the Thirtieth Standard; Deling, platoon leader, and company officers Dongliang and Depei of the Twenty-ninth Standard — all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Sedeben, platoon leader of the Forty-first Standard; Baoshan, assistant quartermaster of the Thirtieth Standard; Deling, platoon leader, and company officers Dongliang and Depei of the Twenty-ninth Standard — all fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 前泰宁鎮右營都司榮錦就養子書記官朗察所，拔所佩劍自裁，侄迎吉及朗察舉室自焚。

translations.literal: Rong Jin, former colonel of the Right Battalion of the Tai'ning garrison town, at the home of his adopted son, clerk Langcha, drew his sword and killed himself; his nephew Yingji and Langcha's entire household burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Jin, former colonel of the Right Battalion of the Tai'ning garrison town, at his adopted son Langcha's home drew his sword and killed himself; his nephew Yingji and Langcha's entire household burned themselves to death.

sentences.zh: 驍騎校哲森以領軍械至省，自刺其腹死。

translations.literal: Xiaoqi School Sergeant Zhesen, having come to the provincial capital to collect arms, stabbed himself in the belly and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhesen, a xiaoqi school sergeant who had come to the provincial capital to collect arms, stabbed himself in the belly and died.

sentences.zh: 陸軍小學教習舉人迎禧，平時於古人之當死不死者輒痛詆之。

translations.literal: Yingxi, licentiate and instructor at the Army Primary School, habitually inveighed bitterly against ancients who should have died but did not.
translations.idiomatic: Yingxi, a licentiate and instructor at the Army Primary School, had long bitterly denounced ancients who ought to have died but did not.

sentences.zh: 變作時，衣冠坐講堂，及難。

translations.literal: When the revolt broke out he sat in the lecture hall in full dress and met calamity.
translations.idiomatic: When the revolt broke out he sat in the lecture hall in full official dress and met his death.

sentences.zh: 副軍需官榮勳仰藥死，子額勒登額、穆貞額殉之。

translations.literal: Deputy quartermaster Rong Xun died by swallowing poison; his sons Ele'denge and Muzhen'e died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy quartermaster Rong Xun poisoned himself; his sons Ele'denge and Muzhen'e died with him.

sentences.zh: 第八鎮執事官錦章謀召同志抵禦，中途遇害，父榮喜即自盡。

translations.literal: Jingzhang, executive officer of the Eighth Division, plotted to call comrades to resist and was killed on the way; his father Rongxi at once killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhang, executive officer of the Eighth Division, plotted to rally comrades to resist but was killed en route; his father Rongxi killed himself at once.

sentences.zh: 司書生恩特亨、雲騎尉榮清、排長倉生光均大罵不屈死。

translations.literal: Clerk Enteheng, Cloud Cavalry Captain Rongqing, and platoon leader Cangshengguang all cursed vehemently and died rather than submit.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Enteheng, Cloud Cavalry Captain Rongqing, and platoon leader Cangshengguang all cursed their enemies and died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 文生楚俊在督署，金培、榮森，司書生鈺壽、訥爾赫圖均在省與難。

translations.literal: Student Chu Jun was at the governor-general's yamen; Jin Pei and Rong Sen; clerks Yushou and Na'erhetu were all in the province and met calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Student Chu Jun was at the governor-general's yamen; Jin Pei and Rong Sen; clerks Yushou and Na'erhetu were all in the provincial capital and died in the calamity.

sentences.zh: 在荊州者，聯長澤麟憤全省盡陷，發槍斃數人，被害。

translations.literal: At Jingzhou, company leader Zelin, indignant that the whole province had fallen, fired his gun and killed several men before he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: At Jingzhou, company leader Zelin, furious that the entire province had fallen, shot and killed several men before he himself was killed.

sentences.zh: 協領志寬，排長額哲蘇、依成額、關斌魁，恩騎尉扎勒杭阿，隊官王榮耀，均亡於陣。

translations.literal: Assistant commandant Zhikuan; platoon leaders Ezhesu, Yicheng'e, and Guan Bankui; Enqi Captain Zalehang'a; and company officer Wang Rongyao — all perished in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant commandant Zhikuan; platoon leaders Ezhesu, Yicheng'e, and Guan Bankui; Enqi Captain Zalehang'a; and company officer Wang Rongyao — all fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 生員秋培城陷自盡。

translations.literal: Licentiate Qiu Pei killed himself when the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, licentiate Qiu Pei killed himself.

sentences.zh: 防禦多瑞仰藥死。

translations.literal: Defense officer Duorui died by swallowing poison.
translations.idiomatic: Defense officer Duorui poisoned himself.

sentences.zh: 記名驍騎校金霖嘗作萬言書，以旗制不良，力主變更，人多笑之。

translations.literal: Registered xiaoqi school sergeant Jin Lin had once written a ten-thousand-word memorial forcefully urging reform of the banner system; many laughed at him.
translations.idiomatic: Registered xiaoqi school sergeant Jin Lin had once submitted a ten-thousand-word memorial forcefully urging reform of the banner system, and many had laughed at him.

sentences.zh: 及變作，發槍自擊死。

translations.literal: When the revolt broke out he fired his gun and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: When the revolt broke out he shot himself dead.

sentences.zh: 又知縣用模範講習所所員根壽於羊樓峒，文生陸營司書生定海於施南府，均死之。

translations.literal: Also Magistrate Yong, institute staff member Genshou at Yangloudong, student Lu Ying, and clerk Dinghai at Shinan prefecture — all died.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Yong, institute staff member Genshou at Yangloudong, student Lu Ying, and clerk Dinghai at Shinan prefecture also died.

sentences.zh: 其後死於江寧者，為生員佔先、文志、恩昌，武生林福。

translations.literal: Those who later died at Jiangning were licentiates Zhanxian, Wenzhi, and Enchang, and military licentiate Lin Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Those who later died at Jiangning were the licentiates Zhanxian, Wenzhi, and Enchang, and the military licentiate Lin Fu.

sentences.zh: 死鎮江者，為生員榮有；

translations.literal: Those who died at Zhenjiang included licentiate Rongyou;
translations.idiomatic: Those who died at Zhenjiang included licentiate Rongyou;

sentences.zh: 副將赫成額則隨端方在資州，兵變遇害；

translations.literal: Deputy general Hecheng'e accompanied Duanfang to Zizhou and was killed when the army mutinied;
translations.idiomatic: Deputy general Hecheng'e was with Duanfang at Zizhou and was killed when the troops mutinied;

sentences.zh: 軍諮府軍諮使良弼，自有傳。

translations.literal: Liangbi, military adviser of the Military Advisory Office, has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Liangbi, military adviser of the Military Advisory Office, has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 宗室德祜，字受之，隸正藍旗，不詳其支派。

translations.literal: Dehu, a member of the imperial clan, style name Shouzhi, belonged to the Plain Blue Banner; his branch of the family is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Dehu of the imperial clan, whose style was Shouzhi, belonged to the Plain Blue Banner; his branch of the family is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，由禮部儀制司郎中選授鳳翔府知府。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Xuantong reign he was selected from director of ceremonies in the Ministry of Rites to be prefect of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Xuantong reign he was promoted from director of ceremonies in the Ministry of Rites to prefect of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，西安兵變，德祜聞警，即與知縣彭毓嵩籌備。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, when the Xi'an army mutinied, Dehu heard the alarm and at once made preparations with magistrate Peng Yusong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year, when the Xi'an army mutinied, Dehu heard the alarm and at once made preparations with magistrate Peng Yusong.

sentences.zh: 有湘人劉瑞麟，以武職留陝，委令募團勇，與參將王某分任防守。

translations.literal: There was a Hunan man, Liu Ruilin, who held a military post in Shaanxi and was ordered to raise militia, sharing defensive duties with Deputy Commander Wang.
translations.idiomatic: A Hunan man named Liu Ruilin, who held a military post in Shaanxi, was ordered to raise militia and shared defensive duties with Deputy Commander Wang.

sentences.zh: 初七夜，匪徒假民軍名號，驟集千餘人，攻府城。

translations.literal: On the night of the seventh, bandits posing under the name of the revolutionary army suddenly gathered more than a thousand men and attacked the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the seventh, bandits posing as the revolutionary army suddenly gathered more than a thousand men and attacked the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 德祜與毓嵩登陴，激勵士卒拒守。

translations.literal: Dehu and Yusong mounted the wall and exhorted the troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Dehu and Yusong mounted the wall and exhorted the troops to hold out.

sentences.zh: 至天明，匪氣奪，將引去，以有內應者，城遽陷。

translations.literal: By daybreak the bandits' spirit flagged and they were about to withdraw, but because there were collaborators within, the city suddenly fell.
translations.idiomatic: By daybreak the bandits' morale faltered and they were about to withdraw, but collaborators within the walls caused the city to fall suddenly.

sentences.zh: 左右擁德祜走避，德祜曰：「此吾死所，尚何避為？

translations.literal: Those beside him urged Dehu to flee, but Dehu said, "This is where I die — why should I flee?
translations.idiomatic: Those beside him urged Dehu to flee, but he said, "This is where I die — why should I flee?

sentences.zh: 」匪蜂至，呼曰：「知府滿人，且宗室，宜速殺之！

translations.literal: " The bandits swarmed in and shouted, "The prefect is a Manchu and of the imperial clan — kill him at once!
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits swarmed in and shouted, "The prefect is a Manchu and of the imperial clan — kill him at once!

sentences.zh: 」遂遇害。

translations.literal: " He was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: He was killed.

sentences.zh: 又殺其幼子二人。

translations.literal: His two young sons were also killed.
translations.idiomatic: His two young sons were also killed.

sentences.zh: 王參將，同州人。

translations.literal: Deputy Commander Wang was from Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commander Wang was from Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 城破，與匪相搏，憤而自戕，舁至署乃死，名未詳。

translations.literal: When the city fell he fought the bandits hand to hand, then in rage killed himself; he was carried to the yamen before he died; his given name is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he fought the bandits hand to hand, then killed himself in rage; he was carried to the yamen before he died; his personal name is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 毓嵩，字籛孫，四川宜賓人。

translations.literal: Yusong, style name Hesun, was a native of Yibin in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yusong, whose style was Hesun, came from Yibin in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 由舉人官教諭。

translations.literal: From juren he became an instructor.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the provincial examination he served as an instructor.

sentences.zh: 學政疏薦，用知縣，選陝西鳳翔，勤聽斷，時方興小學，必令讀經。

translations.literal: Recommended by the education intendant, he was appointed magistrate and selected for Fengxiang in Shaanxi; he heard cases diligently, and when elementary schools were being established he required reading of the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended by the education intendant, he was appointed magistrate and posted to Fengxiang in Shaanxi; he heard cases diligently, and when elementary schools were being established he required pupils to read the classics.

sentences.zh: 城陷後，毓嵩解束帶自經，遇救未絕，乃從容出堂皇北向跪，起語眾曰：「吾有死耳，任爾等為之。

translations.literal: After the city fell Yusong untied his belt and hanged himself; he was rescued before death, then calmly came out to the main hall, knelt facing north, rose and said to the crowd, "I have only death; do as you will.
translations.idiomatic: After the city fell Yusong untied his belt and hanged himself; rescued before he died, he calmly came out to the main hall, knelt facing north, rose and said to the crowd, "I have only death; do as you will.

sentences.zh: 」匪擁至署西北神祠，以白布纏其頸，毓嵩怒詈，遂被戕​​，梟其首去，年六十有二。

translations.literal: " The bandits dragged him to the spirit shrine northwest of the yamen, wound white cloth around his neck; Yusong cursed in rage and was then killed; his head was taken away and displayed; he was sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits dragged him to the spirit shrine northwest of the yamen and wound white cloth around his neck; Yusong cursed them in rage and was killed; his head was taken away and displayed; he was sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 子龢年，奔赴死所，為匪眾所逐，投井死。

translations.literal: His son Henian rushed to the place of death and was driven off by the bandits; he threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: His son Henian rushed to where his father died, was driven off by the bandits, threw himself into a well, and died.

sentences.zh: 楊調元，字龢甫，貴州貴築人。

translations.literal: Yang Tiaoyuan, style name Hefu, was a native of Guizhu in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Tiaoyuan, whose style was Hefu, came from Guizhu in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年進士，授戶部主事。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Guangxu reign he passed the metropolitan examination and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Guangxu reign he passed the metropolitan examination and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂歸，服除，以母老不赴官。

translations.literal: When his father died he returned home; after mourning he did not take office because his mother was old.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died he returned home; after the mourning period he did not take office because his mother was elderly.

sentences.zh: 終母喪，乃入都，改知縣，選陝西紫陽縣。

translations.literal: After his mother's mourning ended he entered the capital, changed to magistrate, and was selected for Ziyang county in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: After his mother's mourning ended he went to the capital, transferred to the magistracy, and was posted to Ziyang county in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 於秦境為極南，居萬山中，為楚、蜀會匪出沒地。

translations.literal: It was the extreme south of Shaanxi, amid ten thousand mountains, a place where bandits from Chu and Shu met and came and went.
translations.idiomatic: It lay at the extreme south of Shaanxi, amid ten thousand mountains, where bandits from Chu and Shu met and roamed.

sentences.zh: 以緝捕有名，遷長安，權華陰。

translations.literal: Famous for pursuit and capture, he was transferred to Chang'an and acted as magistrate of Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: Renowned for pursuit and capture, he was transferred to Chang'an and served as acting magistrate of Huayin.

sentences.zh: 疏濬河渠，复民田五萬畝。

translations.literal: He dredged rivers and canals and restored fifty thousand mu of farmland.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged rivers and canals and restored fifty thousand mu of farmland to cultivation.

sentences.zh: 調華州，以獄事忤上官，解任。

translations.literal: Transferred to Huazhou, he offended his superior over a legal case and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Huazhou, he offended his superior over a legal case and was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 已，复補咸陽，擢華州，署富平、渭南等縣。

translations.literal: Later he was reappointed to Xianyang, promoted to Huazhou, and acted as magistrate of Fuping, Weinan, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: He was later reappointed to Xianyang, promoted to Huazhou, and served as acting magistrate of Fuping, Weinan, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 其署渭南，以宣統三年正月。

translations.literal: His acting post at Weinan began in the first month of the third year of Xuantong.
translations.idiomatic: He took up his acting post at Weinan in the first month of the third year of Xuantong.

sentences.zh: 先是，南方革命軍數起皆不得志，始改計結學生之隸新軍籍者，潛伏待應。

translations.literal: Earlier, revolutionary armies in the south had risen repeatedly without success; they then changed their plan to win over students enrolled in the new army, who lay hidden waiting to respond.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, revolutionary armies in the south had risen repeatedly without success; they then changed their plan to recruit students serving in the new army, who lay hidden waiting to rise.

sentences.zh: 陝軍勢弱，則又結會匪以厚其力。

translations.literal: Shaanxi's forces were weak, so they also allied with secret-society bandits to strengthen themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's forces were weak, so they also allied with secret-society bandits to strengthen themselves.

sentences.zh: 八月十九日，鄂變起，九月朔，陝變繼作。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth day of the eighth month the Hubei revolt broke out; on the first of the ninth month the Shaanxi revolt followed.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth day of the eighth month the Hubei revolt broke out; on the first of the ninth month the Shaanxi revolt followed.

sentences.zh: 諸守令多委印去，調元獨謂守土吏當與城存亡，亟召紳民議守禦。

translations.literal: Most magistrates abandoned their seals and fled; Tiaoyuan alone said that officials who hold the land must live or die with the city, and urgently summoned gentry and people to discuss defense.
translations.idiomatic: Most magistrates abandoned their seals and fled; Tiaoyuan alone held that officials charged with the land must live or die with the city, and urgently summoned gentry and commoners to plan its defense.

sentences.zh: 渭南北有號「刀客」者，殺人尋仇，數犯法，至是感調元義，爭效命，集者萬餘人，檄邑紳武進士韓有書統之。

translations.literal: North of Weinan were men called "Knife Guests" who killed in vendetta and repeatedly broke the law; now moved by Tiaoyuan's righteousness they vied to serve, and more than ten thousand gathered; he ordered local gentry and military jinshi Han Youshu to command them.
translations.idiomatic: North of Weinan were men called "Knife Guests" who killed in vendetta and repeatedly broke the law; now moved by Tiaoyuan's righteousness they vied to serve, and more than ten thousand gathered; he ordered the local gentry and military jinshi Han Youshu to command them.

sentences.zh: 時鄰匪蜂起，渭南以守禦嚴，不能入。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in swarms in neighboring areas, but Weinan's defenses were strict and they could not enter.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in swarms in neighboring areas, but Weinan's defenses were strict and they could not enter.

sentences.zh: 臨潼武生張士原揚言受軍政府命，驟率眾徇城下，調元登陴語之曰：「吏所職，保民耳。

translations.literal: Zhang Shiyuan, military licentiate of Lintong, claimed he had orders from the military government and suddenly led a crowd to the foot of the wall; Tiaoyuan mounted the wall and said to him, "An official's duty is only to protect the people.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shiyuan, a military licentiate of Lintong, claimed he had orders from the military government and suddenly led a crowd to the foot of the wall; Tiaoyuan mounted the wall and said to him, "An official's duty is only to protect the people.

sentences.zh: 無如所犯，則釋兵入見。

translations.literal: If you have no crimes to answer for, lay down your arms and come in to see me.
translations.idiomatic: If you have committed no crimes, lay down your arms and come in to see me.

sentences.zh: 必怙威圖一逞，則視力所極，當與決生死。

translations.literal: If you must rely on force to have your way, then wherever my strength reaches I will fight you to the death.
translations.idiomatic: If you insist on relying on force to have your way, then wherever my strength reaches I will fight you to the death.

sentences.zh: 」士原知不可侮，遂屏騎入廨，以議貸餉事，語侵調元。

translations.literal: " Shiyuan knew he could not be bullied, dismounted and entered the yamen to discuss borrowing supplies; his words insulted Tiaoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: " Shiyuan saw he could not intimidate him, dismounted and entered the yamen to discuss borrowing supplies, and his words insulted Tiaoyuan.

sentences.zh: 調元至是，躑躅廨後園中，仰天歎曰：「吾誼應死，所以委曲遷就，欲脫吾民兵​​禍而後歸死耳。

translations.literal: Tiaoyuan at this point paced in the garden behind the yamen, looked up to heaven and sighed, "By righteousness I ought to die; the reason I stooped to compromise was to spare my militia calamity and then return to die.
translations.idiomatic: Tiaoyuan at this point paced in the garden behind the yamen, looked up to heaven and sighed, "By righteousness I ought to die; the reason I stooped to compromise was to spare my militia calamity and then return to face death.

sentences.zh: 卼辱至此，尚可一息偷生乎？

translations.literal: Humiliated to this point — can I still steal a moment's life?
translations.idiomatic: Humiliated to this point — can I still steal another breath of life?

sentences.zh: 」遂投井死。

translations.literal: " He then threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: He threw himself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 民聞調元殉難，執士原磔之，並殺陝都督所派副統領及同黨數十人以徇。

translations.literal: When the people heard Tiaoyuan had died for the cause, they seized Shiyuan and dismembered him, and also killed the deputy commander and dozens of his associates sent by the Shaanxi governor to make an example.
translations.idiomatic: When the people heard Tiaoyuan had died for the cause, they seized Shiyuan and dismembered him, and also killed the deputy commander and dozens of his associates sent by the Shaanxi governor as a warning.

sentences.zh: 有書時出擊他盜，馳歸，葬調元畢家原。

translations.literal: Youshu was out attacking other bandits; he galloped back and buried Tiaoyuan at Bijiayuan.
translations.idiomatic: Youshu was out attacking other bandits; he galloped back and buried Tiaoyuan at Bijiayuan.

sentences.zh: 調元通古學，工詩文，有訓纂堂集、說文解字均譜等書。

translations.literal: Tiaoyuan was versed in classical learning, skilled in poetry and prose, and left works including Xunzhuan Hall Collected Writings and Junpu of the Shuowen Jiezi.
translations.idiomatic: Tiaoyuan was versed in classical learning and skilled in poetry and prose; his works include Xunzhuan Hall Collected Writings and Junpu of the Shuowen Jiezi.

sentences.zh: 所作篆書，人尤寶之。

translations.literal: The seal script he wrote people especially treasured.
translations.idiomatic: People especially treasured the seal script he wrote.

sentences.zh: 楊宜瀚，字吟海，四川成都人。

translations.literal: Yang Yihan, style name Yinhai, was a native of Chengdu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yihan, whose style was Yinhai, came from Chengdu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 兄宜治，官太常寺卿。

translations.literal: His elder brother Yizhi was vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Yizhi served as vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 宜瀚好學，嘗入烏魯木齊都統金順幕中，治軍書，知名，保知縣。

translations.literal: Yihan loved learning; he once entered the staff of Jin Shun, military governor of Urumqi, handling military documents, became well known, and was recommended for magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Yihan loved learning; he once served on the staff of Jin Shun, military governor of Urumqi, handling military documents, became well known, and was recommended for the magistracy.

sentences.zh: 中順天鄉試舉人，以知縣發陝西，補興平，調寶雞。

translations.literal: He passed the Shuntian provincial examination as juren, was dispatched as magistrate to Shaanxi, filled Xingping, and was transferred to Baoji.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the Shuntian provincial examination as juren, was posted as magistrate to Shaanxi, served at Xingping, and was transferred to Baoji.

sentences.zh: 以經術飾吏事，與調元齊名。

translations.literal: He adorned official business with classical learning and was as famous as Tiaoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He brought classical learning to bear on official business and was as renowned as Tiaoyuan.

sentences.zh: 署華州知州，民軍圍署索餉，以威劫入甘露寺中，有以事繫獄賴宜瀚平反得出者，約護宜瀚出。

translations.literal: Acting as prefect of Huazhou, revolutionary troops surrounded the yamen demanding pay; they forced him at swordpoint into the Ganlu Temple; some who had been imprisoned and freed through Yihan's reversal of their cases agreed to escort Yihan out.
translations.idiomatic: While acting as prefect of Huazhou, revolutionary troops surrounded the yamen demanding pay and forced him at swordpoint into the Ganlu Temple; some who had been imprisoned and freed through Yihan's reversal of their cases agreed to escort him out.

sentences.zh: 入夜，宜瀚獨至神殿自經死。

translations.literal: At night Yihan went alone to the shrine hall and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: That night Yihan went alone to the shrine hall and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 遺書親友，意思安閒，謂已得死所，無可哀者。

translations.literal: In letters to friends his meaning was calm; he said he had found the place to die and there was nothing to mourn.
translations.idiomatic: In letters to friends his tone was calm; he said he had found the place to die and there was nothing to mourn.

sentences.zh: 陳問紳，字子仲，湖北安陸人。

translations.literal: Chen Wenshen, style name Zizhong, was a native of Anlu in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wenshen, whose style was Zizhong, came from Anlu in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 入貲為縣令，發陝西，權甘泉，以能緝捕稱。

translations.literal: He purchased office as magistrate, was dispatched to Shaanxi, acted at Ganquan, and was known for ability in pursuit and capture.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased office as magistrate, was posted to Shaanxi, served as acting magistrate at Ganquan, and was known for ability in pursuit and capture.

sentences.zh: 調白水，邑刀匪素難治，武昌變起，乘間應之，糾眾攻城。

translations.literal: Transferred to Baishui — a county where knife bandits were always hard to govern — when the Wuchang revolt broke out they seized the opportunity to respond, gathering a crowd to attack the city.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Baishui — a county where knife bandits had always been hard to govern — when the Wuchang revolt broke out they seized the opportunity to respond and gathered a crowd to attack the city.

sentences.zh: 時問紳初受任，一切無備，乃集紳民告之以不忍以一人故致全境糜爛，遽出城，大罵不屈死。

translations.literal: Wenshen had just taken office and had no preparations; he gathered gentry and people and told them he could not bear to bring ruin on the whole district for one man's sake, then rushed out of the city, cursed loudly, and died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Wenshen had just taken office and was wholly unprepared; he gathered gentry and commoners and told them he could not bear to bring ruin on the whole district for one man's sake, then rushed out of the city, cursed loudly, and died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 妻吳，以護印不與，同被戕，並斃傭婦某。

translations.literal: His wife Wu, refusing to surrender the seal, was killed together with him, and a serving woman was also beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Wu, refusing to surrender the official seal, was killed with him, and a serving woman was also beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 德銳，滿洲人。

translations.literal: Derui was a Manchu.
translations.idiomatic: Derui was a Manchu.

sentences.zh: 官秦中久，歷長安、三原諸縣，有循聲。

translations.literal: He had long served in Shaanxi, holding Chang'an, Sanyuan, and other counties, and had a reputation for benevolent rule.
translations.idiomatic: He had long served in Shaanxi, holding Chang'an, Sanyuan, and other counties, and enjoyed a reputation for benevolent rule.

sentences.zh: 西安變作，八旗人多被禍，德銳時居會城，變兵突入，語德銳：「公得民心，我曹不忍死公，請速出城！

translations.literal: When the Xi'an revolt broke out many banner people suffered calamity; Derui was then living in the provincial capital; mutinous troops burst in and said to Derui, "You have won the people's hearts — we cannot bear to kill you; please leave the city at once!
translations.idiomatic: When the Xi'an revolt broke out many banner people suffered calamity; Derui was then living in the provincial capital; mutinous troops burst in and said to him, "You have won the people's hearts — we cannot bear to kill you; please leave the city at once!

sentences.zh: 」答曰：「感汝等意，然予滿人也，不忍獨生，刃加予頸可也。

translations.literal: " He answered, "I am grateful for your intent, but I am a Manchu and cannot bear to live alone; put the blade to my neck.
translations.idiomatic: " He answered, "I am grateful for your kindness, but I am a Manchu and cannot bear to live on alone; put the blade to my neck."

sentences.zh: 」遽起奪刀自刺死，妻、子均自裁。

translations.literal: " He at once rose, seized a knife, and stabbed himself to death; his wife and children all killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: " He at once rose, seized a knife, and stabbed himself to death; his wife and children all killed themselves.

sentences.zh: 皮潤璞，湖北大冶人。

translations.literal: Pi Runpu was a native of Daye in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Pi Runpu came from Daye in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 官榆林縣典史，有強項稱。

translations.literal: He served as registrar clerk of Yulin County and was known for his unyielding disposition.
translations.idiomatic: He held the post of registrar clerk in Yulin County and was famed for his stern, unyielding character.

sentences.zh: 變作，匪徒縛榆林鎮總兵張某、中營游擊瑞某送獄，潤璞斥之。

translations.literal: When the revolt broke out, bandits bound Zhang, commander of Yulin Garrison, and Rui, vice-commander of the middle battalion, and sent them to prison; Runpu rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: When the uprising broke out, bandits seized the Yulin garrison commander Zhang and middle-battalion vice-commander Rui and locked them in jail; Runpu denounced them.

sentences.zh: 群怒，以利刃相擬，不為動，紛加以刃，分股體為數段。

translations.literal: The mob grew enraged, pointed sharp blades at him, but he did not flinch; they hacked at him repeatedly and cut his limbs into several pieces.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd flew into a rage and menaced him with sharp blades, yet he did not flinch; they hacked at him until his body was cut into several pieces.

sentences.zh: 妻聞訊，即以身殉。

translations.literal: When his wife heard the news, she died with him at once.
translations.idiomatic: When his wife heard what had happened, she took her own life in devotion.

sentences.zh: 榆林守備穆克精額同時死，闔門自盡。

translations.literal: Yulin garrison commandant Mukujing'e died at the same time; his entire household killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Mukujing'e, the Yulin garrison commandant, died at the same time, and his whole household took their own lives.

sentences.zh: 時殉難者，候補道荣麟，字仲文，滿洲人。

translations.literal: Among those who died in the crisis were Expectant Intendant Ronglin, style name Zhongwen, a Manchu.
translations.idiomatic: Among those who perished were Expectant Intendant Ronglin, known as Zhongwen, a Manchu.

sentences.zh: 變作，方榷白河釐金，全家投井死。

translations.literal: When the revolt broke out he was collecting the likin at Baihe; his whole family threw themselves into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the uprising broke out he was supervising likin collection at Baihe; his entire family drowned themselves in a well.

sentences.zh: 候補知州張存善，字次章。

translations.literal: Expectant prefect Zhang Cunshan, style name Cizhang.
translations.idiomatic: Expectant prefect Zhang Cunshan, styled Cizhang.

sentences.zh: 榷鳳翔鹽釐，死事所。

translations.literal: He was collecting salt likin at Fengxiang and died at his post.
translations.idiomatic: He was supervising salt likin at Fengxiang and died in the line of duty.

sentences.zh: 候補直隸州知州寶坪，字子鈞，西安駐防。

translations.literal: Expectant prefect of a Zhili department Baoping, style name Zijun, garrisoned at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Expectant prefect of a Zhili department, Baoping (styled Zijun), was stationed at the Xi'an garrison.

sentences.zh: 一門殉難者七人。

translations.literal: Seven members of one household died in the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Seven people from a single household perished in the catastrophe.

sentences.zh: 候補同知廣啟，字少漁；

translations.literal: Expectant sub-prefect Guangqi, style name Shaoyu;
translations.idiomatic: Expectant sub-prefect Guangqi, styled Shaoyu;

sentences.zh: 候補通判嚴濟，字寬甫：均滿洲人，與於難。

translations.literal: Expectant prefectural judge Yan Ji, style name Kuanfu: both were Manchus and met disaster in the uprising.
translations.idiomatic: Expectant prefectural judge Yan Ji, styled Kuanfu — both were Manchus who perished in the uprising.

sentences.zh: 張毅，字仁府，直隸天津人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi, style name Renfu, was a native of Tianjin in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi, styled Renfu, came from Tianjin in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 父夢元，官福建布政使，護台灣巡撫，以清廉著稱，卒，贈太子少保。

translations.literal: His father Mengyuan served as Fujian provincial treasurer and acting Taiwan governor; famed for integrity, on his death he was posthumously enfeoffed as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: His father Mengyuan had served as Fujian provincial treasurer and acting Taiwan governor; renowned for integrity, on his death he was posthumously enfeoffed as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 毅由廕生官部曹，改道員，分山西，奏調陝西，授甘涼道。

translations.literal: Yi entered office through yin privilege as a ministry clerk, was transferred to intendant, assigned to Shanxi, memorialized for transfer to Shaanxi, and appointed Gansu Circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Yi entered service through yin privilege as a ministry clerk, rose to intendant, was posted to Shanxi, then memorialized for transfer to Shaanxi and appointed Gansu Circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年六月，擢安徽提法使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Xuantong he was promoted to Anhui provincial judge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Xuantong 3 he was promoted to Anhui provincial judge.

sentences.zh: 八月，自隴入秦，將入覲，九月，抵乾州，變作，道梗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he left Longyou for Qin and was to proceed to audience; in the ninth month he reached Qianzhou, the revolt broke out, and the roads were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he left Longyou for Shaanxi en route to audience; in the ninth month he reached Qianzhou, the uprising broke out, and travel was cut off.

sentences.zh: 變軍偵知之，請為參謀官，斥之，攖眾怒，羈留不得脫。

translations.literal: The mutineers learned of him and asked him to serve as staff officer; he rebuked them, provoked the crowd's anger, and was detained unable to escape.
translations.idiomatic: The mutineers learned of him and invited him to serve as staff officer; he refused and provoked their wrath, and was held unable to escape.

sentences.zh: 會疾作，州人知毅賢，言於變軍，乃出就醫。

translations.literal: When he fell ill, the people of the prefecture, knowing Yi's worth, spoke to the mutineers, and he was released to seek medical care.
translations.idiomatic: When he fell ill, knowing Yi's worth, the people of the prefecture pleaded with the mutineers, and he was released to seek treatment.

sentences.zh: 毅念惟一死可自完，十一月初十日夜加醜，乘間投井死。

translations.literal: Yi felt that only death could preserve his integrity whole; on the night of the tenth day of the eleventh month he took poison, seized an interval, and threw himself into a well to die.
translations.idiomatic: Yi believed only death could preserve his integrity; on the night of the tenth of the eleventh month he took poison and, seizing a moment alone, threw himself into a well.

sentences.zh: 毅無官守，中道遘變，卒完大節，世尤多之。

translations.literal: Yi had no official charge to keep; he met the uprising midway, yet in the end preserved his great integrity — the age especially praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Yi held no official post to defend; he met the uprising en route, yet preserved his integrity to the end — contemporaries especially admired him.

sentences.zh: 喜明，字哲臣，西安駐防。

translations.literal: Ximing, style name Zhechen, garrisoned at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Ximing, styled Zhechen, was stationed at the Xi'an garrison.

sentences.zh: 舉人。

translations.literal: He was a provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: He had passed the provincial examinations.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年九月，民軍猝起，攻旗營，將軍文瑞督戰，喜明領兵百餘人，獨樹一幟，誓以書生效死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year of Xuantong the revolutionary army rose suddenly and attacked the banner camp; General Wen Rui directed the defense; Ximing led more than a hundred men, raised his own standard alone, and vowed to live or die by the written pledge.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Xuantong 3 the revolutionary army rose suddenly and attacked the banner camp; General Wen Rui directed the defense; Ximing led more than a hundred men under his own banner and swore to live or die by his written pledge.

sentences.zh: 戰不利，歸告母曰：「吾屬死不免。

translations.literal: The battle went badly; returning home he told his mother, "Our kind cannot escape death.
translations.idiomatic: The battle went badly; returning home he told his mother, "People like us cannot escape death.

sentences.zh: 」母曰：「婦女以潔身為重，可受辱乎？

translations.literal: " His mother said, "For women, purity of body is paramount — can one endure disgrace?
translations.idiomatic: " His mother said, "For a woman, bodily purity is everything — can one endure dishonor?

sentences.zh: 」帥子婦二、幼孫一，投井死。

translations.literal: " Leading two daughters-in-law and one young grandson, she threw herself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: " She led her two daughters-in-law and a young grandson into a well and drowned.

sentences.zh: 喜明有三女匿鄰廟中，走入手刃之，蘸血書壁曰：「喜哲臣三女死於此。

translations.literal: Ximing had three daughters hidden in a neighboring temple; he went in and killed them with his own hand, dipped blood and wrote on the wall, "The three daughters of Ximing Zhechen died here.
translations.idiomatic: Ximing had three daughters hidden in a neighboring temple; he went in and killed them with his own blade, dipped blood, and wrote on the wall, "The three daughters of Ximing Zhechen died here.

sentences.zh: 」還至家，縱火自焚死。

translations.literal: " Returning home, he set fire to the house and burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: " He returned home, set the house ablaze, and burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 附生春祥，素端謹。

translations.literal: Licentiate Chunxiang had always been upright and cautious.
translations.idiomatic: Licentiate Chunxiang had always been upright and careful.

sentences.zh: 聞變後，語兄若弟曰：「城破家必亡，自古全家盡節，有光史冊，吾原死矣。

translations.literal: After hearing of the uprising he said to his elder and younger brothers, "When the city falls the household is doomed; since antiquity whole families who died together have shone in the histories — I am willing to die.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard of the uprising he told his brothers, "When the city falls our house is doomed; since antiquity households that died together whole have shone in the histories — I am ready to die.

sentences.zh: 」則皆應曰：「諾！

translations.literal: " They all answered, "Agreed!
translations.idiomatic: " They all answered, "Yes!

sentences.zh: 」城陷，聞砲聲近，曰：「可矣！

translations.literal: " When the city fell and cannon fire drew near, he said, "It is time!
translations.idiomatic: " When the city fell and the sound of cannon drew near, he said, "It is time!

sentences.zh: 」遂偕兄、弟、妻、子輩十餘口焚死，無一免者。

translations.literal: " He then burned to death together with his elder and younger brothers, wife, children, and more than ten others — none escaped.
translations.idiomatic: " He and his brothers, wife, children, and more than ten kin burned to death together — none survived.

sentences.zh: 直隸州州判阿爾精額，榷釐金於方計堡，受代還，道咸陽，變軍將劫之，為之語曰：「吾當未亂​​時，志欲以忠報國，敢偷活耶？

translations.literal: Zhili department judge A'erjing'e was collecting likin at Fangjibao; on returning from handing over his post he passed Xianyang; mutineers were about to rob him, and he said to them, "Before the disorder my wish was to repay the state with loyalty — would I dare live in cowardice?
translations.idiomatic: Zhili department judge A'erjing'e was collecting likin at Fangjibao; returning after handing over his post he passed Xianyang; mutineers were about to rob him, and he said, "Before the disorder I meant to repay the state with loyalty — would I steal my life?

sentences.zh: 」義之，不加害。

translations.literal: " They respected him and did him no harm.
translations.idiomatic: " Moved by his words, they did him no harm.

sentences.zh: 乃入邸舍，肅衣冠，北向自刎死。

translations.literal: He then entered his lodging, put on formal dress, faced north, and cut his own throat to die.
translations.idiomatic: He entered his quarters, dressed formally, faced north, and cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 妻張氏，即吞金以殉。

translations.literal: His wife Lady Zhang swallowed gold and died with him.
translations.idiomatic: His wife, the Zhang lady, swallowed gold and died with him.

sentences.zh: 城破時陣亡者，為協領斌恆、恩瑞、存福、培基，佐領貴升、特克什肯、慶喜、巴克三圖、恆秀、瑞明、額哲本、達朗阿、興智、恩壽、玉祥、西拉本、奇徹亨、恩撤亨，防禦存喜、存升、恩成、林福、色清額、平升、胡圖靈額、惠文、鶴齡、奇巽、蘇克敦、訥拉春、惠源、呢克通阿、哲爾精額、惠祥，驍騎校奎亮、林啟、啟弟正目林璋、都倫太、景文太、薩立善、文昭、伊吉斯琿、智厚、惠慶、惠啟，副官惠璋、鹽大使文煥，舉人惠斌，生員金常，武舉人德森布，騎都尉昌廣、益光，雲騎尉俊亮、和瑞、松善、特伸布、富海、勝春、海亮、多鑾太、達林、和順、忠雲、玉恆、培文、存祿、倭什琿、鳳玉、惠撤亨，恩騎尉培緒、鳳山、恩瑞、奎德、貴成、錫齡、崇喜、倭仁額。

translations.literal: Those who fell in battle when the city was taken included battalion commanders Binheng, Enrui, Cunfu, and Peiji; company commanders Guisheng, Tekeshiken, Qingxi, Baketu, Hengxiu, Ruiming, Ezheben, Dalang'a, Xingzhi, Enshou, Yuxiang, Xilaben, Qicheheng, and Enceheng; garrison defense officers Cunxi, Cunsheng, Encheng, Linfu, Seqing'e, Pingsheng, Hutuling'e, Huiwen, Heling, Qixun, Sukedun, Nelachun, Huiyuan, Nike'tong'a, Zhe'erjing'e, and Huixiang; brave-rider commandants Kuiliang, Linqi, Linqi's younger brother chief clerk Linzhang, Duluntai, Jingwentai, Salishan, Wenzhao, Yijisi'hun, Zhihou, Huiqing, and Huiqi; deputy officers Huizhang and salt commissioner Wen Huan; provincial graduate Huibin; student Jin Chang; military graduate Desenbu; commandants of cavalry Changguang and Yiguang; cloud-rider commandants Junliang, Herui, Songshan, Teshenbu, Fuhai, Shengchun, Hailiang, Duoluantai, Dalin, Heshun, Zhongyun, Yuheng, Peiwen, Cunlu, Woshihun, Fengyu, and Huiceheng; and grace-rider commandants Peixu, Fengshan, Enrui, Kuide, Guicheng, Xiling, Chongxi, and Woren'e.
translations.idiomatic: Those killed in battle when the city fell included numerous battalion and company commandants, garrison defense officers, brave-rider commandants, deputy officers, graduates, and cloud- and grace-rider commandants — a long roll of banner officers.

sentences.zh: 徇難者，為佐領圖切琿，候補直隸州知州寶坪，直隸州州同俊興。

translations.literal: Those who suffered in the calamity included company commander Tuqiehun, Expectant Zhili department prefect Baoping, and Zhili department vice-prefect Junxing.
translations.idiomatic: Those who perished in the uprising included company commander Tuqiehun, Expectant Zhili department prefect Baoping, and department vice-prefect Junxing.

sentences.zh: 候補知縣德銳自刺死，妻、子同殉。

translations.literal: Expectant magistrate Derui stabbed himself to death; his wife and children died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Expectant magistrate Derui killed himself; his wife and children perished with him.

sentences.zh: 防禦多英，與長子舉人奎成率妻、女等投井死，次子生員奎章，伏井慟哭從死，族弟奎斌、奎莊皆死之。

translations.literal: Garrison defense officer Duoying led his eldest son, provincial graduate Kuicheng, with wife and daughters into a well to die; his second son, student Kuizhang, wept at the well and followed them in death; cousins Kuibin and Kuizhuang also died.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison defense officer Duoying led his eldest son Kuicheng, a provincial graduate, with wife and daughters into a well; his second son Kuizhang wept at the well and died with them; cousins Kuibin and Kuizhuang also perished.

sentences.zh: 巡官惠祥率警生守城，城陷，投井死，家屬從死者六人。

translations.literal: Patrol officer Huixiang led police cadets to defend the city; when the city fell he threw himself into a well, and six family members died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol officer Huixiang led police cadets in defending the city; when it fell he drowned himself in a well, and six kin died with him.

sentences.zh: 從子廣興既殉，母趙氏，年六十餘，執短刀闖入民軍，欲殺敵，尋自刎死。

translations.literal: His nephew Guangxing having already died in devotion, his mother Lady Zhao, over sixty, seized a short knife, rushed into the revolutionary army intending to kill the enemy, and soon cut her own throat to die.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Guangxing having already perished, his mother Lady Zhao, past sixty, seized a short knife, charged into the revolutionary ranks to kill the enemy, and soon cut her own throat.

sentences.zh: 生員音德本走多公祠自經死，弟領催額哲亨城陷死。

translations.literal: Student Yindeben fled to Duogong Shrine and hanged himself; his younger brother, levy chief Ezheheng, died when the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: Student Yindeben fled to Duogong Shrine and hanged himself; his younger brother, levy chief Ezheheng, died when the city fell.

sentences.zh: 傷亡者，佐領圖們布、善印、全瑞。

translations.literal: Among the wounded were company commanders Tububu, Shanyin, and Quanrui.
translations.idiomatic: Among the wounded were company commanders Tububu, Shanyin, and Quanrui.

sentences.zh: 旗兵之死於此役有名冊可稽者，凡千餘人，官弁兵丁之家屬遇害及自盡者尤眾。

translations.literal: Banner soldiers who died in this engagement and whose names can be verified in the registers numbered more than a thousand; the families of officers and soldiers who were killed or killed themselves were even more numerous.
translations.idiomatic: More than a thousand banner soldiers who died in this battle are recorded by name; the families of officers and men killed or who took their own lives were even more numerous.

sentences.zh: 論者謂各省駐防，於辛亥國變，以西安死難為最烈且最多雲。

translations.literal: Commentators say that among garrison posts in every province during the Xinhai transformation, Xi'an's deaths in devotion were the fiercest and the most numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Observers held that among provincial garrisons in the Xinhai transformation, Xi'an suffered the fiercest and greatest toll of martyrs.

sentences.zh: 譚振德，字子明，直隸天津人。

translations.literal: Tan Zhende, style name Ziming, was a native of Tianjin in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Zhende, styled Ziming, came from Tianjin in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 始入武備學堂，調新建陸軍，派充山西四十三協協統。

translations.literal: He first entered the military academy, was transferred to the newly formed army, and was appointed commander of the forty-third brigade in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He first entered the military academy, joined the newly formed army, and was appointed commander of Shanxi's forty-third brigade.

sentences.zh: 時山西僅陸軍一協，振德寬而有制，兵士親之。

translations.literal: At the time Shanxi had only one brigade of the new army; Zhende was lenient yet disciplined, and the soldiers were attached to him.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi then had only one new-army brigade; Zhende was lenient yet firm, and the men were devoted to him.

sentences.zh: 巡撫陸鍾琦履任之三月，武昌變作，陝西響應，召軍官議省防。
