translations.literal: Rongkui was also from Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Rongkui was also from Anhui.

sentences.zh: 王振畿，字化東，山東滕縣人。

translations.literal: Wang Zhenji, style name Huadong, was a native of Teng County in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhenji, styled Huadong, came from Teng County in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 天津武備學堂畢業，充哨長，累擢至統領，改道員，入滇，總辦兵備處，治軍有節制。

translations.literal: Graduate of the Tianjin military academy, he served as platoon leader, rose repeatedly to commanding general, became intendant, entered Yunnan, headed the military preparations office, and governed troops with discipline.
translations.idiomatic: A Tianjin academy graduate, he rose from platoon leader to commanding general and intendant, entered Yunnan, headed military preparations, and kept strict discipline.

sentences.zh: 變作，欲墜城死，僅傷左股，遂被執。

translations.literal: When the revolt broke out he wished to throw himself from the wall to die but only wounded his left thigh and was seized.
translations.idiomatic: When revolt broke out he tried to throw himself from the wall but only wounded his thigh and was seized.

sentences.zh: 勸降不從，見害。

translations.literal: Urged to surrender he would not; he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Urged to surrender he refused and was killed.

sentences.zh: 張嘉鈺，字武平，湖南鳳凰廳人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiayu, style name Wuping, was a native of Fenghuang Subprefecture in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiayu, styled Wuping, came from Fenghuang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 起世職，累官至總兵。

translations.literal: From hereditary office he rose repeatedly to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: From hereditary office he rose to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，署騰越鎮。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong he acted as Tengyue garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 he acted as Tengyue garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 武昌變

translations.literal: When Wuchang revolted
translations.idiomatic: When Wuchang revolted

sentences.zh: 起，有自省遺嘉銍書諷其達時變者，嘉鈺謂：「我所知者，與城存亡而已，其他非我所能行，亦非所忍聞也。

translations.literal: some in the province sent Jiayu a letter from Yunnan mocking him for not adapting to the times; Jiayu said, "What I know is only to live or die with the city — the rest is not for me to do, nor can I bear to hear it.
translations.idiomatic: some sent a Yunnan letter mocking his failure to adapt; Jiayu said, "I know only to live or die with the city — the rest I cannot do or bear to hear.

sentences.zh: 」未幾，騰越防軍起應民軍，九月初六日圍鎮署，出堂皇彈壓，兵猝入，被戕。

translations.literal: " Before long Tengyue defense troops rose with the revolutionary army; on the sixth day of the ninth month they besieged the garrison yamen; he came out to the main hall to suppress them; troops burst in and he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon Tengyue garrison troops joined the revolution; on the sixth of the ninth month they besieged the yamen; he came out to suppress them and was killed.

sentences.zh: 陈兆棠，字樹甘，湖南桂陽州人。

translations.literal: Chen Zhaotang, style name Shugan, was a native of Guiyang Prefecture in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhaotang, styled Shugan, came from Guiyang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 父士傑，山東巡撫，自有傳。

translations.literal: His father Shijie was Shandong governor and has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shijie, Shandong governor, has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，兆棠官惠州府知府。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong Zhaotang was prefect of Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 Zhaotang was Huizhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 九月，粵中黨人起應武昌，總督張鳴岐遁香港，民軍遂踞省城，設軍政府。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Guangdong party men rose in response to Wuchang; Governor Zhang Mingqi fled to Hong Kong; the revolutionary army seized the provincial capital and set up a military government.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Guangdong rose with Wuchang; Governor Zhang Mingqi fled to Hong Kong; revolutionaries seized the capital and set up a military government.

sentences.zh: 潮州鎮趙國賢自盡死，所統防軍擾亂，守、道、知縣皆逃。

translations.literal: Chaozhou commander Zhao Guoxian killed himself; the defense army he commanded fell into disorder; prefect, intendant, and magistrates all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozhou commander Zhao Guoxian killed himself; his defense army fell into disorder; prefects and magistrates fled.

sentences.zh: 士民懼，堅留兆棠收撫防軍，部署未定，二十八日，民黨糾眾攻府署，火及宅門，左右挾兆棠出。

translations.literal: Gentry and people in fear firmly kept Zhaotang to pacify the defense army; before arrangements were settled, on the twenty-eighth day party men gathered a crowd to attack the prefectural yamen; fire reached the residence gate; attendants dragged Zhaotang out.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing chaos, locals kept Zhaotang to pacify the army; on the twenty-eighth party men attacked the yamen; fire reached his gate; attendants dragged him out.

sentences.zh: 民軍懸賞購執，令輸餉十萬貸死，兆棠曰：「死則死耳，安有鉅金助爾謀反？

translations.literal: The revolutionary army offered a reward for his capture and demanded a hundred thousand taels in pay to spare his life; Zhaotang said, "Death is death — how could there be great gold to aid your rebellion?
translations.idiomatic: Revolutionaries offered a reward and demanded a hundred thousand taels for his life; Zhaotang said, "Death is death — what great gold would aid your rebellion?

sentences.zh: 」眾怒，縛之柱，中十三槍乃絕。

translations.literal: " The crowd in anger bound him to a pillar; thirteen shots struck him before he died.
translations.idiomatic: " The mob bound him to a pillar; thirteen shots killed him.

sentences.zh: 國賢自有傳。

translations.literal: Guoxian has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Guoxian has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 馮汝楨，字萊雲，浙江桐鄉人。

translations.literal: Feng Ruzhen, style name Laiyun, was a native of Tongxiang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ruzhen, styled Laiyun, came from Tongxiang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 以諸生捐知縣，發廣東。

translations.literal: As licentiate he purchased magistrate and was dispatched to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: A licentiate, he purchased magistrate and was posted to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 榷商讞獄，咸舉其職。

translations.literal: Collecting commercial likin and judging cases, in all he fulfilled his duties.
translations.idiomatic: In likin collection and judging cases he fulfilled every duty.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年七月，攝西寧。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Xuantong he acted in Xining.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Xuantong 3 he acted in Xining.

sentences.zh: 廣州變起，黨軍闖縣署，脅汝楨懸白旗示歸順，持不可。

translations.literal: When Guangzhou revolted revolutionary troops burst into the county yamen and forced Ruzhen to fly a white flag showing submission; he would not.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzhou rose revolutionaries burst into the yamen and forced him to fly a white flag; he refused.

sentences.zh: 俄而槍聲作，乃朝衣冠出大堂，眾爭前，槍刃交集，洞胸穿肋，斷右臂，死之。

translations.literal: Soon gunfire broke out; he then came out in court dress to the main hall; the crowd rushed forward; guns and blades crossed; his chest was pierced, ribs run through, right arm severed — he died.
translations.idiomatic: Gunfire broke out; he came out in court dress; the crowd rushed in; blades and guns crossed; his chest and ribs were pierced, his right arm severed — he died.

sentences.zh: 何承珍，字性存，湖南湘潭人。

translations.literal: He Chengzhen, style name Xingcun, was a native of Xiangtan in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He Chengzhen, styled Xingcun, came from Xiangtan in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 少治說文學。

translations.literal: In youth he studied etymology.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he studied etymology.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，學政陶方琦按臨長沙，以漯字為題，承珍徵引詳贍，文譽以起。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu Education Commissioner Tao Fangqi examined at Changsha and set the character luo as the topic; Chengzhen cited sources in full detail and his literary reputation began to rise.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 Education Commissioner Tao Fangqi examined at Changsha with the character luo as topic; Chengzhen cited sources fully and his reputation rose.

sentences.zh: 光緒季年，廣東陸路提督秦炳直招入幕，於軍事多所贊畫。

translations.literal: In the last years of Guangxu Guangdong land-route commander Qin Bingzhi recruited him to his staff, and he often advised on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In late Guangxu Guangdong commander Qin Bingzhi recruited him and he often advised on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 時提督駐惠州，以總稽查任之。

translations.literal: The commander was then stationed at Huizhou and appointed him chief inspector.
translations.idiomatic: The commander was at Huizhou and made him chief inspector.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年八月，革命軍起，惠及鄰境匪皆蠢動。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Xuantong the revolutionary army rose; Huizhou and neighboring bandits all stirred.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Xuantong 3 revolution broke out; Huizhou and neighboring bandits stirred.

sentences.zh: 聞營官有通敵者，密告炳直，而營務處劉殿元以全力讓主帥自任，否則偕死。

translations.literal: Hearing a camp officer was in contact with the enemy he secretly reported to Bingzhi; camp affairs officer Liu Dianyuan yielded full authority to the commander or would die with him.
translations.idiomatic: Learning a camp officer contacted the enemy he reported to Bingzhi; Liu Dianyuan yielded full authority to the commander or would die with him.

sentences.zh: 承珍感其意，以首觸地謝之。

translations.literal: Chengzhen was moved and bowed his head to the ground in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Moved, Chengzhen kowtowed in thanks.

sentences.zh: 亡何，餉匱薪米竭，援師不至，承珍以死自誓。

translations.literal: Before long pay was exhausted and firewood and grain gone; relief troops did not come; Chengzhen vowed to die.
translations.idiomatic: Soon pay, firewood, and grain were gone and no relief came; Chengzhen vowed to die.

sentences.zh: 城陷，夕歸私室，自書絕命時日，置衣帶中，並遺書誡子，自經死。

translations.literal: When the city fell he returned to his private quarters in the evening, wrote the time of his death, placed it in his belt, left a letter admonishing his son, and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he wrote his time of death, put it in his belt, left a letter to his son, and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 炳直上聞，以「忠義可嘉」褒之。

translations.literal: Bingzhi reported upward and praised him as "loyalty and righteousness commendable."
translations.idiomatic: Bingzhi reported upward and praised his "loyalty and righteousness."

sentences.zh: 白如鏡，字顯齋，隸鑲黃旗漢軍。

translations.literal: Bai Rujing, style name Xianzhai, belonged to the Bordered Yellow Banner Hanjun.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Rujing, styled Xianzhai, belonged to the Bordered Yellow Banner Hanjun.

sentences.zh: 由筆帖式補鑾儀衛官，出為興寧營都司。

translations.literal: From clerk he was appointed to the Imperial Bodyguard and went out as Xingning battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: From clerk he entered the Imperial Bodyguard and became Xingning battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，署潮州左營游擊，兵變不屈死。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong he acted as Chaozhou left-battalion vice-commander and died unyielding in military mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 he acted as Chaozhou left-battalion vice-commander and died unyielding in mutiny.

sentences.zh: 何培清，字鏡亭，廣東歸善人。

translations.literal: He Peiqing, style name Jingting, was a native of Guishan in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He Peiqing, styled Jingting, came from Guishan in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 入提標，補千總。

translations.literal: He entered the provincial command and was appointed company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the provincial command and became company commander.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年，領連和防營，提督秦炳直才之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Guangxu he led the Lianhe defense battalion; Commander Qin Bingzhi valued his talent.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 34 he led the Lianhe defense battalion; Commander Qin Bingzhi valued him.

sentences.zh: 調博羅，剿羅桂幫匪，盡殲之。

translations.literal: Transferred to Boluo he suppressed the Luogui gang bandits and destroyed them all.
translations.idiomatic: At Boluo he suppressed the Luogui gang and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 會鄂變，粵應之，民軍猝集，攻博羅。

translations.literal: When Hubei revolted Guangdong responded; revolutionary troops gathered suddenly and attacked Boluo.
translations.idiomatic: When Hubei rose Guangdong followed; revolutionaries suddenly attacked Boluo.

sentences.zh: 培清以三百人登陴守兩晝夜，敵不得逞。

translations.literal: Peiqing with three hundred men mounted the walls and held two days and nights; the enemy could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Peiqing with three hundred men held the walls two days and nights; the enemy could not break in.

sentences.zh: 奸民開門迎民軍，執培清，不欲死之。

translations.literal: Traitors opened the gate to welcome the revolutionary army; Peiqing was seized; they did not wish to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Traitors opened the gate; Peiqing was seized but they did not mean to kill him.

sentences.zh: 甫出，猝遇羅桂餘黨，出不意，狙擊死之。

translations.literal: Just as he left he suddenly met Luogui gang remnants who, taking him unawares, shot him dead.
translations.idiomatic: Just outside he met Luogui remnants who ambushed and shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 時又有黃兆熊者，名家玟，以字行，湖南湘潭人。

translations.literal: At the time there was also Huang Zhaoxiong, personal name Jiawen, known by his style, a native of Xiangtan in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Huang Zhaoxiong, known by his style Jiawen, from Xiangtan in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 久從秦炳直為惠安水師營哨官。

translations.literal: He had long followed Qin Bingzhi as a Huian naval battalion platoon officer.
translations.idiomatic: He had long served Qin Bingzhi as a Huian naval platoon officer.

sentences.zh: 博羅既失，民軍薄惠州，兆熊被調入城守，三日目不交睫。

translations.literal: After Boluo was lost revolutionary troops pressed Huizhou; Zhaoxiong was called into the city to defend and for three days did not close his eyes.
translations.idiomatic: After Boluo fell revolutionaries pressed Huizhou; Zhaoxiong was called in to defend and went three days without sleep.

sentences.zh: 城陷，傳提督被害，悲愴不欲生。

translations.literal: When the city fell word spread that the commander had been killed; grief-stricken he did not wish to live.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell word said the commander was killed; grief-stricken he did not wish to live.

sentences.zh: 時全城搶攘，獨攜槍至城堞間，以足趾觸槍機，洞貫胸腹死。

translations.literal: While the whole city was in uproar he alone took his gun to the battlements, touched the trigger with his toe, and was pierced through chest and belly to die.
translations.idiomatic: While the city rioted he alone took his gun to the wall, fired with his toe on the trigger, and shot himself through chest and belly.

sentences.zh: 張德潤，南雄人。

translations.literal: Zhang Derun was a native of Nanxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Derun came from Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 以千總充香山巡防營管帶官。

translations.literal: As company commander he served as Xiangshan patrol battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: As company commander he led the Xiangshan patrol battalion.

sentences.zh: 革軍入縣城，守南門力戰，援絕被執，殺之，投屍江中。

translations.literal: When revolutionary troops entered the county seat he defended the south gate and fought fiercely; aid cut off he was seized, killed, and his body thrown into the river.
translations.idiomatic: When revolutionaries entered he defended the south gate; cut off he was seized, killed, and thrown in the river.

sentences.zh: 嘉應州游擊柏某，時亦以兵變遇難。

translations.literal: Jiaying vice-commander Bo, name lost, also met disaster in military mutiny at the time.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaying vice-commander Bo, name lost, also died in mutiny.

sentences.zh: 張振德，並失其籍。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhende — his native place is also lost.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhende — his native place is also lost.

sentences.zh: 廣西候補知府，充巡防隊統領。

translations.literal: Expectant Guangxi prefect, serving as commander of the patrol force.
translations.idiomatic: Expectant Guangxi prefect commanding the patrol force.

sentences.zh: 十月，潯州亂，率師至黃茅規進剿，眾寡不敵，中槍死。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Xunzhou revolted; he led troops to Huangmao planning to advance in suppression; outnumbered he was shot dead.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Xunzhou revolted; he led troops to Huangmao to suppress; outnumbered he was shot dead.

sentences.zh: 時南寧府知府攝思恩府舒志，亦以兵變死之。

translations.literal: At the time Nanning prefect acting as Si'en prefect Shu Zhi also died in military mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Nanning prefect acting Si'en prefect Shu Zhi also died in mutiny.

sentences.zh: 來秀，字樂三，姓聶格里氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Laixiu, style name Lesan, surname Nieligeli, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Laixiu, styled Lesan, of the Nieligeli clan, was a Bordered Blue Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 由繙譯生考取筆帖式，歷官刑部，屢決疑獄。

translations.literal: From translation student he passed the clerk examination, served in the Ministry of Justice, and repeatedly decided doubtful cases.
translations.idiomatic: From translation student to clerk he served in the Ministry of Justice and repeatedly decided doubtful cases.

sentences.zh: 充軍機章京。

translations.literal: He served as a Grand Council secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Grand Council secretary.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十三年，出知汀州府。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year of Guangxu he went out as Tingzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 he became Tingzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 大吏議加汀鹽價，力爭罷。

translations.literal: Grandees proposed raising Ting salt prices; he argued forcefully and had it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Grandees proposed raising Ting salt prices; he argued and stopped it.

sentences.zh: 武昌事起，福建響應，總督松壽殉難，全省無主。

translations.literal: When Wuchang rose Fujian responded; Governor Song Shou died in devotion and the whole province was without a head.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuchang rose Fujian followed; Governor Song Shou died and the province was headless.

sentences.zh: 來秀在官多惠政，士紳憂來秀滿洲，為人指目，謁請護避汕頭，來秀以大義自矢，不之允。

translations.literal: Laixiu in office had many benevolent policies; gentry feared that as a Manchu he would be marked out and asked him to take refuge at Shantou; Laixiu pledged himself to great principle and would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Laixiu had many benevolent policies; gentry feared his Manchu origin and urged refuge at Shantou; he refused on principle.

sentences.zh: 九月三十日，郡城驟懸白旗。

translations.literal: On the thirtieth day of the ninth month the prefectural city suddenly flew white flags.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirtieth of the ninth month the city suddenly flew white flags.

sentences.zh: 來秀知事不可回，朝服坐大堂，北向叩頭，仰藥死。

translations.literal: Laixiu knew matters could not be reversed; in court dress he sat in the main hall, kowtowed facing north, and died by poison.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing all was lost, he sat in court dress in the main hall, kowtowed north, and took poison.

sentences.zh: 松壽自有傳。

translations.literal: Song Shou has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 劉念慈，字晉芝，湖北鍾祥人。

translations.literal: Liu Nianci, style name Jinzhi, was a native of Zhongxiang in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Nianci, styled Jinzhi, came from Zhongxiang in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 由廩生選教諭，俸滿，以知縣發福建，補永安。

translations.literal: From government student he was selected instructor; when his salary term ended he was dispatched to Fujian as magistrate and appointed to Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: From government student to instructor, then posted to Fujian as magistrate of Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 福州既亂，土匪倚山險，聚眾數百人，念慈募勇督剿。

translations.literal: After Fuzhou fell into disorder, bandits relied on mountain passes, gathered several hundred men, and Nianci recruited braves to lead suppression.
translations.idiomatic: After Fuzhou fell, mountain bandits gathered hundreds; Nianci recruited braves to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 匪負嵎抵抗，勇被槍死，念慈亦重傷，為匪擁去，索銀幣取贖。

translations.literal: Bandits resisted from strong positions; braves were shot dead; Nianci was also heavily wounded, seized by bandits, and ransom in silver was demanded.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits held strong ground; braves were shot; Nianci was badly wounded, seized, and ransom demanded.

sentences.zh: 念慈即間遣人持絕命書歸，且曰：「慎毋來贖，以增羞貽累！

translations.literal: Nianci at once secretly sent someone with a farewell letter home, saying, "Take care not to come ransom me — to add shame and burden!
translations.idiomatic: He secretly sent a farewell letter home: "Do not ransom me — do not add shame and burden!

sentences.zh: 」卒絕粒不食死。

translations.literal: " In the end he refused all food and starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: " He starved himself to death.

sentences.zh: 李秉鈞，漢軍正白旗人。

translations.literal: Li Bingjun was a Hanjun of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bingjun was a Plain White Banner Hanjun.

sentences.zh: 由謄錄敘知縣，選泰宁，有治聲。

translations.literal: From copyist he rose to magistrate, was selected for Taining, and had a reputation for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: From copyist to magistrate he was assigned Taining and governed well.

sentences.zh: 革命變作，慨然曰：「國亡與亡，義也！

translations.literal: When the revolution broke out he said with emotion, "When the state perishes I perish — that is duty!
translations.idiomatic: When revolution broke out he said, "When the state perishes I perish — that is duty!

sentences.zh: 第縣治無官，民將失所。

translations.literal: Only if the county seat lacks an official the people will lose their place.
translations.idiomatic: But if the county lacks an official the people will be lost.

sentences.zh: 」召紳士議保衛，法既定，仰藥死。

translations.literal: " He summoned gentry to discuss defense; when the plan was set he took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: " He summoned gentry to plan defense; when the plan was set he took poison.

sentences.zh: 繼妻烏蘇氏亦抑藥殉之。

translations.literal: His second wife, the Wusu lady, also took poison and died with him.
translations.idiomatic: His second wife, Lady Wusu, also took poison and died with him.

sentences.zh: 王榮綬，字笛青，湖南善化人。

translations.literal: Wang Rongshou, style name Diqing, was a native of Shanhua in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rongshou, styled Diqing, came from Shanhua in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以軍功起家，官甘肅。

translations.literal: He rose through military merit and served in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through military merit and served in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十八年，改選連江縣知縣，嚴於捕緝，黨人莫敢留縣境。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu he was transferred to magistrate of Lianjiang County, strict in arrest and pursuit; party men dared not remain in the county.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 he became Lianjiang magistrate, strict in pursuit; revolutionaries dared not stay in the county.

sentences.zh: 受代寓省城，被拘至軍政府，責以前事，抗辭不屈，被害。

translations.literal: After handing over his post he lodged in the provincial capital, was seized and taken to the military government, blamed for past conduct, resisted with defiant words, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: After leaving office he lodged in the capital, was seized by the military government, rebuked for past acts, resisted, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 定煊，福州駐防。

translations.literal: Dingxuan was garrisoned at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dingxuan was stationed at the Fuzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 諸生。

translations.literal: Licentiate.
translations.idiomatic: He was a licentiate.

sentences.zh: 有幹略，官佐領。

translations.literal: He had ability and strategy and held the rank of company commander.
translations.idiomatic: Capable and resourceful, he held company commander rank.

sentences.zh: 武昌變起，將軍樸壽日料軍實、簡卒伍。

translations.literal: When Wuchang revolted General Pusou daily inspected military stores and selected troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuchang rose General Pusou daily inspected stores and selected troops.

sentences.zh: 旗民能勝兵者，皆授以兵，而任定煊為捷勝營管帶，日夕操練。

translations.literal: Banner people who could bear arms were all given weapons, and Dingxuan was made commander of the Jiesheng battalion, drilling day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Able bannermen were armed and Dingxuan was made Jiesheng battalion commander, drilling constantly.

sentences.zh: 防軍圖變，於九月十八日，揚言旗營將開砲洗城以懼眾。

translations.literal: The defense army plotted mutiny; on the eighteenth day of the ninth month they spread word that the banner camp would open cannon to wash the city and frighten the people.
translations.idiomatic: Defense troops plotted mutiny; on the eighteenth of the ninth month they claimed the banner camp would shell the city.

sentences.zh: 四鼓，砲聲隆起，分撲軍、督兩署。

translations.literal: At the fourth watch cannon fire rose and they rushed the military and governor's yamens separately.
translations.idiomatic: At the fourth watch guns fired and they stormed the military and governor's offices.

sentences.zh: 樸壽親督所部血戰兩晝夜，防禦長瑞、驍騎校巴揚阿主軍書，發憤從戰，相繼殞於陣。

translations.literal: Pusou personally directed his troops in bloody fighting for two days and nights; garrison defense Changrui and brave-rider commandant Bayang'a handled military documents, fought in fury, and both fell in battle in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Pusou led two days and nights of bloody fighting; Changrui and Bayang'a fought furiously and both fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 前者僵，後者繼，變軍不支，漸引卻。

translations.literal: When the front fell the rear followed; the mutineers could not hold and gradually withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: As leaders fell others took their place; mutineers gave ground and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 偵利槍巨業皆在於山，定煊從樸壽於二十日夕，短衣草屨，督死士襲山壘，深入，中砲死。

translations.literal: Scouts reported that fine guns and heavy equipment were all on the hill; on the evening of the twentieth Dingxuan followed Pusou in short coat and straw sandals, leading dare-to-die men to storm the hill fort, went deep in, and was killed by cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Fine arms were on the hill; on the twentieth evening Dingxuan in plain dress led dare-to-die men to storm it and was killed by cannon.

sentences.zh: 長瑞、巴揚阿均繙譯舉人，同隸駐防之前鋒森俊、蘇都裡、達哈使、尚阿里，領催桂斌、慶銘，舉人​​松音，均陣亡。

translations.literal: Changrui and Bayang'a were both translation graduates; with them from the garrison fell vanguard Senjun, Suduli, Dahashi, Shang'ali, levy chiefs Guibin and Qingming, and graduate Songyin — all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Changrui and Bayang'a were translation graduates; vanguard officers, levy chiefs, and graduate Songyin also fell.

sentences.zh: 教員麟瑞，舉人裕彤與兄筆帖式裕豐，族兄哨官鑠欽額，均殉難。

translations.literal: Instructor Linrui, graduate Yutong and his elder brother clerk Yufeng, and cousin platoon officer Shuoe'e, all died in the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Instructor Linrui, graduate Yutong, clerk Yufeng, and cousin platoon officer Shuoe'e all perished.

sentences.zh: 樸壽自有傳。

translations.literal: Pusou has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Pusou has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 王有宏，字金波，直隸天津人。

translations.literal: Wang Youhong, style name Jinbo, was a native of Tianjin in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Youhong, styled Jinbo, came from Tianjin in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，投效銘軍，充兵目。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi he joined the Ming army as a soldier.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5 he joined the Ming army as a soldier.

sentences.zh: 自平定發、捻餘孽，與剿台灣番法人攻台灣諸役，均隨軍有功，擢至游擊。

translations.literal: From suppressing remnant Nian and Taiping bands, fighting Taiwan aborigines in the French Taiwan campaign, and other campaigns, he followed the army with merit and rose to brigade vice-commander.
translations.idiomatic: From suppressing Nian and Taiping remnants to the French Taiwan campaign he served with merit and rose to brigade vice-commander.

sentences.zh: 日本渝盟，奏調山海關辦防務。

translations.literal: When Japan broke the alliance he was memorialized for transfer to Shanhaiguan to handle coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Japan broke the alliance he was sent to Shanhaiguan for coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 和議成，入江南防營，以緝梟匪勞，記名總兵。

translations.literal: After peace he entered the Jiangnan defense camp and, for suppressing salt smugglers, was recorded for promotion to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: After peace he joined Jiangnan defense and was noted for regional commander for suppressing salt smugglers.

sentences.zh: 江蘇巡撫鹿傳霖器之，從入秦，扈從兩宮回鑾。

translations.literal: Jiangsu Governor Lu Chuanlin valued him; he followed him into Shaanxi and escorted the two palaces on the return procession.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Lu Chuanlin valued him; he followed to Shaanxi and escorted the court home.

sentences.zh: 尋為河南巡撫張人駿奏留，倚以練軍。

translations.literal: Soon Henan Governor Zhang Renjun memorialized to retain him and relied on him to drill troops.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Governor Zhang Renjun retained him to drill troops.

sentences.zh: 人駿督兩廣，移督兩江，皆從。

translations.literal: When Renjun governed Guangdong and then the two Jiangs, he followed in both posts.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Renjun to Guangdong and then the two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 管江南緝捕營，兼統總督衛隊。

translations.literal: He commanded the Jiangnan arrest battalion and concurrently led the governor's guard.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded Jiangnan arrest forces and the governor's guard.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年八月，湖北告變，檄統選鋒十營會提督張勛江防軍守江寧，嘗請率三千人赴滬守製造局，斷蘇、杭鐵道，未果。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Xuantong Hubei reported revolt; he was ordered to lead ten selected battalions with Commander Zhang Xun's river-defense army to guard Jiangning; he once asked to lead three thousand men to Shanghai to guard the arsenal and cut the Suzhou-Hangzhou railway — it was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Xuantong 3 Hubei revolted; he led ten battalions with Zhang Xun to guard Jiangning and once proposed three thousand men for Shanghai and cutting the railway — denied.

sentences.zh: 無何，江蘇巡撫程德全宣布獨立，率兵攻江寧，提督張勛與戰，頗勝，而變軍別出一支攻督署，有宏以機關砲擊卻之。

translations.literal: Before long Jiangsu Governor Cheng Dequan declared independence, led troops to attack Jiangning; Commander Zhang Xun fought and won somewhat, but mutineers sent another force against the governor's yamen; Youhong repelled them with machine guns.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Cheng Dequan declared independence and attacked Jiangning; Zhang Xun fought well, but mutineers struck the governor's yamen; Youhong repelled them with machine guns.

sentences.zh: 十月初旬，德全以江浙聯軍至，麕集薄城，有宏馳出通濟門，以三百人戰。

translations.literal: In early the tenth month Dequan's Jiangsu-Zhejiang allied army gathered and pressed the city; Youhong rode out through Tongji Gate with three hundred men to fight.
translations.idiomatic: In early the tenth month the Jiangsu-Zhejiang allied army pressed the city; Youhong rode out Tongji Gate with three hundred men.

sentences.zh: 民軍以遠鏡測知有宏所在，發槍，子中左腹，猶植立，督軍士進擊，左右舁至醫院，乃絕。

translations.literal: The revolutionary army used telescopes to locate Youhong and fired; a bullet struck his left belly; he still stood upright directing the advance; attendants carried him to the hospital and he died.
translations.idiomatic: Revolutionaries spotted him with telescopes and shot him in the left belly; he still stood directing the fight until carried to hospital and died.

sentences.zh: 電聞，贈太子少保，諡壯武。

translations.literal: Reported by telegraph, he was posthumously enfeoffed Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Zhuangwu.
translations.idiomatic: By telegraph he was posthumously made Junior Guardian with the title Zhuangwu.

sentences.zh: 何師程，字云門。

translations.literal: He Shicheng, style name Yunmen.
translations.idiomatic: He Shicheng, styled Yunmen.

sentences.zh: 由襲騎都尉擢副將，保總兵，補江南督標中軍。

translations.literal: From hereditary commandant of cavalry he rose to deputy general, was recommended for regional commander, and appointed middle army of the Jiangnan governor's standard.
translations.idiomatic: From hereditary commandant he rose to deputy general and commanded the Jiangnan governor's middle army.

sentences.zh: 十月十二日，寧垣陷，自戕。

translations.literal: On the twelfth day of the tenth month Ning walls fell and he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth of the tenth month Ning fell and he killed himself.

sentences.zh: 黃凱臣，本名彩，以字行，江蘇江都人。

translations.literal: Huang Kaichen, original name Cai, known by his style, was a native of Jiangdu in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Kaichen, born Cai, known by his style, came from Jiangdu in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 入徐寶山虎字營為哨官，敘功至游擊，以事去職，至賣茶自給。

translations.literal: He entered Xu Baoshan's Tiger Character Battalion as platoon officer, rose by merit to brigade vice-commander, left office over an affair, and came to sell tea for a living.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Xu Baoshan's Tiger Battalion, rose to brigade vice-commander, left office, and sold tea for a living.

sentences.zh: 武昌變起，江寧將軍鐵良添募十營助城守，凱臣領其一。

translations.literal: When Wuchang revolted Jiangning General Tie Liang added ten battalions to aid in defense; Kaichen commanded one.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuchang rose General Tie Liang raised ten defense battalions; Kaichen led one.

sentences.zh: 省城既陷，各營相約懸白旗，凱臣語所親曰：「城不守，而相率降附，吾實恥之！

translations.literal: After the provincial capital fell each battalion agreed to fly white flags; Kaichen said to intimates, "The city is not held yet they all rush to surrender — I am truly shamed!
translations.idiomatic: When the capital fell battalions agreed to fly white flags; Kaichen told intimates, "The city is lost yet they surrender — I am ashamed!

sentences.zh: 」聯軍至，橫刀大呼殺敵，馳入陣，被戕。

translations.literal: " When the allied army came he drew his blade, shouted to kill the enemy, charged into the ranks, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: " When allies came he drew his blade, shouted to kill the enemy, charged in, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 戚從雲，徐州人。

translations.literal: Qi Congyun was a native of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Congyun came from Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 由行伍官千總，隸江蘇巡防營，以能緝捕名。

translations.literal: From the ranks he became company commander in the Jiangsu patrol battalion and was famed for able pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: From the ranks he became company commander in Jiangsu patrol forces, famed for pursuit.

sentences.zh: 蘇、滬獨立時，從雲率巡防一營駐黃渡，抵抗不從，遂為民軍所戕。

translations.literal: When Jiangsu and Shanghai declared independence Congyun led one patrol battalion stationed at Huangdu, resisted and would not submit, and was killed by revolutionary troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangsu and Shanghai declared independence he held Huangdu, refused to submit, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 盛成，字挹軒，本荊州駐防。

translations.literal: Sheng Cheng, style name Yixuan, was originally from the Jingzhou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Cheng, styled Yixuan, was originally from the Jingzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 同治初，金陵克復，調江寧，由驍騎校累擢鑲黃旗佐領。

translations.literal: In early Tongzhi when Jinling was recovered he was transferred to Jiangning and rose from brave-rider commandant to Bordered Yellow Banner company commander.
translations.idiomatic: In early Tongzhi, when Jinling was recovered, he was transferred to Jiangning and rose to Bordered Yellow Banner company commander.

sentences.zh: 民軍攻江寧，知城不可守，約知交城破各挈孥就火藥庫，謀同死。

translations.literal: When revolutionary troops attacked Jiangning he knew the city could not be held; he agreed with close friends that when the city fell each would bring family to the powder magazine and die together.
translations.idiomatic: When revolutionaries attacked Jiangning he knew the city was lost and agreed with friends to bring their families to the powder magazine and die together.

sentences.zh: 十月十一日，城破，有言繳械免死者，眾要盛成往，不應，率子婦趙，孫國瑞，女三，赴藥庫，攜酒痛飲，炷香以待炸發。

translations.literal: On the eleventh day of the tenth month the city fell; some said surrender arms and be spared; the crowd wanted Sheng Cheng to go — he would not; he led his daughter-in-law Zhao, grandson Guorui, and three daughters to the magazine, drank wine deeply, lit incense, and waited for the explosion.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh the city fell; some offered surrender; he refused, led daughter-in-law Zhao, grandson Guorui, three daughters to the magazine, drank, lit incense, and waited to die.

sentences.zh: 哈郎阿，字叔芬。

translations.literal: Halang'a, style name Shufen.
translations.idiomatic: Halang'a, styled Shufen.

sentences.zh: 素與盛成善，聞之，亦挈妻張，子成仁、成義，女一，往，同時熸焉。

translations.literal: Long friendly with Sheng Cheng, on hearing he also brought his wife Zhang, sons Chengren and Chengyi, and one daughter, went there, and all burned together.
translations.idiomatic: Close to Sheng Cheng, he brought wife Zhang, sons Chengren and Chengyi, and a daughter, and all burned together.

sentences.zh: 旁近旗民無老幼男婦，巨響一震，死不知數。

translations.literal: Nearby banner people, old and young, men and women — at one great blast the dead were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Nearby banner people of every age — one great blast killed untold numbers.

sentences.zh: 南山，字壽民。

translations.literal: Nanshan, style name Shoumin.
translations.idiomatic: Nanshan, styled Shoumin.

sentences.zh: 充貼寫，累擢防禦。

translations.literal: He served as copyist and rose repeatedly to garrison defense officer.
translations.idiomatic: A copyist, he rose to garrison defense officer.

sentences.zh: 初從將軍鐵良駐軍北極閣，城破，知同僚集都統署，馳入，言曰：「吾輩受國厚恩，今宜發天良，背城一戰。

translations.literal: At first he followed General Tie Liang garrisoned at Beiji Pavilion; when the city fell he knew colleagues were gathered at the commandant's office; he rushed in and said, "We have received the state's great grace — now we should summon conscience and fight with our backs to the wall.
translations.idiomatic: He followed General Tie Liang at Beiji Pavilion; when the city fell he went to the commandant's office and said, "We owe the state great grace — we should fight with our backs to the wall.

sentences.zh: 不濟，則以死繼之！

translations.literal: If we fail, then die in succession!
translations.idiomatic: If we fail, we die in turn!

sentences.zh: 」無應者。

translations.literal: " No one answered.
translations.idiomatic: " No one answered.

sentences.zh: 出召軍士語如前，亦無應者。

translations.literal: He went out and summoned soldiers with the same words — again no answer.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned soldiers with the same words — again no answer.

sentences.zh: 恚甚，發槍自擊死。

translations.literal: Furious, he fired his gun and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, he shot himself.

sentences.zh: 妻某，聞南山殉節，抱其子縱火自焚死。

translations.literal: His wife, on hearing Nanshan died for integrity, embraced her son and burned herself to death.
translations.idiomatic: His wife, hearing of his death, embraced her son and burned herself.

sentences.zh: 培秀，字希賢。

translations.literal: Peixiu, style name Xixian.
translations.idiomatic: Peixiu, styled Xixian.

sentences.zh: 先以襁褓子授其戚，以阿芙蓉膏飲一女、一侄女，夫婦自焚死。

translations.literal: First he gave his infant son to a kinsman, fed a girl and a niece opium, and he and his wife burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: He gave his infant to a kinsman, gave opium to a girl and niece, and he and his wife burned themselves.

sentences.zh: 防禦松柏與妻、子、女八人，驍騎校恩鈞夫婦，副前鋒寶林全家，防禦長年，均自焚死。

translations.literal: Garrison defense Songbai with wife, son, and eight daughters; brave-rider commandant Enjun and wife; deputy vanguard Baolin's whole family; garrison defense Changnian — all burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison officers Songbai, Enjun, Baolin's family, and Changnian all burned themselves.

sentences.zh: 隸某旗洪某，聞變，先以妻女投官井，與同居劉永祥闔室舉火自焚。

translations.literal: Hong of a certain banner, on hearing of the uprising, first threw wife and daughters into the official well, then with co-resident Liu Yongxiang the whole household set fire and burned themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Bannerman Hong, hearing of revolt, drowned wife and daughters in the official well, then burned with Liu Yongxiang's household.

sentences.zh: 洪失其名，永祥，微者也。

translations.literal: Hong's personal name is lost; Yongxiang was a humble man.
translations.idiomatic: Hong's name is lost; Yongxiang was obscure.

sentences.zh: 中學教習興發，約同營前鋒錦秀同投塘水死。

translations.literal: Middle-school instructor Xingfa agreed with camp vanguard Jinxiu to drown together in the pond.
translations.idiomatic: Middle-school instructor Xingfa agreed with vanguard Jinxiu to drown in the pond.

sentences.zh: 小學校長富勒渾布，嘗以世濁獨清，誓與屈靈均為伍，有欲縛獻民軍者，躍入水，猶抗聲語曰：​​「吾今日遂吾志矣！

translations.literal: Primary-school principal Fulehunbu, who had sworn to keep himself pure in a turbid age like Qu Yuan, when some wished to bind him and hand him to the revolutionary army leapt into the water and still cried aloud, "Today I fulfill my wish!
translations.idiomatic: Principal Fulehunbu, who had vowed purity like Qu Yuan, leapt into water when men would hand him over, crying, "Today I fulfill my wish!

sentences.zh: 」不受援，死。

translations.literal: " He would not accept rescue and died.
translations.idiomatic: " He refused rescue and died.

sentences.zh: 防禦嚴德海，驍騎校愛仁阿、榮生，均率妻、女、子、婦，千總色勒善夫婦，佐領廣照，世職關秀昆，相率投水死。

translations.literal: Garrison defense Yandehai, brave-rider commandants Airen'a and Rongsheng, all leading wives, daughters, sons, and daughters-in-law; company commander Seleshan and wife; company commander Guangzhao; hereditary officer Guan Xiukun — all threw themselves into the water.
translations.idiomatic: Yandehai, Airen'a, Rongsheng, and many others with their families threw themselves into the water.

sentences.zh: 防禦果仁布，城破自盡。

translations.literal: Garrison defense Guorenbu, when the city fell, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison defense Guorenbu killed himself when the city fell.

sentences.zh: 世職鹿鳴，自經死。

translations.literal: Hereditary officer Luming hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary officer Luming hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 隊官汝霖、彭興，教練官恩錫，執事官魁穠，均以不屈被害。

translations.literal: Company officers Rulin and Pengxing, drill officer Enxi, and attendant officer Kuinong were all killed for refusing to yield.
translations.idiomatic: Company officers Rulin and Pengxing, drill officer Enxi, and attendant Kuinong were killed unyielding.

sentences.zh: 陣亡者，為驍騎校趙金泉，教練官鵬興，排長海祥，砲隊官趙壽昌。

translations.literal: Those who fell in battle were brave-rider commandant Zhao Jinquan, drill officer Pengxing, platoon leader Haixiang, and artillery officer Zhao Shouchang.
translations.idiomatic: Fallen in battle: Zhao Jinquan, Pengxing, Haixiang, and Zhao Shouchang.

sentences.zh: 被戕者，千總富有，世職金珍、祥泰、韓萬興、鴻錫、侯恩、俊卜、金海、永潮、韓萬富，文生衣吉斯渾。

translations.literal: Those killed were company commander Fuyou, hereditary officers Jinzhen, Xiangtai, Han Wanxing, Hongxi, Hou En, Junbu, Jinhai, Yongchao, Han Wanfu, and student Yijisihun.
translations.idiomatic: Killed: Fuyou, many hereditary officers, and student Yijisihun.

sentences.zh: 凡旗兵戰死及眷屬與難見姓名者數百人。

translations.literal: Banner soldiers who died in battle and dependents who met disaster numbered several hundred by name.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred banner soldiers and dependents died or perished by name.

sentences.zh: 事定，掩埋叢塚凡十三處，其數不可稽。

translations.literal: When matters settled, thirteen mass burial mounds were heaped — the numbers cannot be verified.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward thirteen mass burial mounds were made — the count cannot be verified.

sentences.zh: 生員長明，以在杭州武備學堂肄業，為同學斫之死。

translations.literal: Student Changming, studying at the Hangzhou military academy, was hacked to death by classmates.
translations.idiomatic: Student Changming, at the Hangzhou military academy, was hacked to death by classmates.

sentences.zh: 桂城，字仲籓，姓伊布杼克氏，蒙古鑲紅旗人，世京口駐防。

translations.literal: Guicheng, style name Zhongfan, surname Yibuzhuoke, was a Mongol of the Bordered Red Banner, garrisoned at Jingkou for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Guicheng, styled Zhongfan, of the Yibuzhuoke clan, was a Bordered Red Banner Mongol garrisoned at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 由生員入武備學堂，考送日本振武、士官諸學校。

translations.literal: From licentiate he entered the military academy and was sent to Japan's Shinbu and officer schools.
translations.idiomatic: A licentiate, he entered the military academy and was sent to Japan's Shinbu and officer schools.

sentences.zh: 入聯隊實習，調江寧為憲兵協軍校，管陸軍警察營。

translations.literal: After unit internship he was transferred to Jiangning as military police company officer of the gendarmerie, commanding the army police battalion.
translations.idiomatic: After internship he became Jiangning gendarmerie company officer and commanded the army police battalion.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年九月，變作，遺妻、子槍令自裁；

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year of Xuantong, when the revolt broke out, he left guns for his wife and son to kill themselves;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Xuantong 3, when revolt broke out, he left guns for wife and son to kill themselves;

sentences.zh: 族人在軍者，咸勗以大義。

translations.literal: kinsmen in the army were all urged with great principle.
translations.idiomatic: kinsmen in the army were urged to duty.

sentences.zh: 時第九鎮統制徐紹楨駐秣陵關，往謁，知桂城不與同志也，拘荒祠中。

translations.literal: Ninth Division commander Xu Shaozhen was then at Moling Pass; Guicheng went to visit him; knowing Guicheng would not join the cause, he was detained in a ruined temple.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth Division commander Xu Shaozhen was at Moling Pass; Guicheng visited him, was known to oppose the cause, and was held in a ruined temple.

sentences.zh: 新軍敗雨花台，遷怒桂城，擁之出，中數槍死。

translations.literal: When the new army was defeated at Yuhuatai they vented rage on Guicheng, dragged him out, and shot him many times to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the new army lost at Yuhuatai they dragged Guicheng out and shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 後二年，補諡剛愍。

translations.literal: Two years later he was posthumously given the title Gangmin.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he received the posthumous title Gangmin.

sentences.zh: 延浩，字子餘，蒙古鄂依羅特氏，漢姓文。

translations.literal: Yanhao, style name Ziyu, of the Mongol Eoyiluote clan, Han surname Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhao, styled Ziyu, of the Eoyiluote Mongols, Han surname Wen.

sentences.zh: 既老，赤面白須，善騎射，如少年。

translations.literal: Though old, with red face and white beard, he rode and shot like a youth.
translations.idiomatic: Though old, red-faced and white-bearded, he rode and shot like a youth.

sentences.zh: 官協領，以原品食俸。

translations.literal: He was battalion commander, eating salary at his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was battalion commander on his original salary.

sentences.zh: 載穆殉節，默不語，具衣冠北面再拜，僵臥不食卒。

translations.literal: When Zaimu died for integrity he spoke not, put on full dress, kowtowed twice facing north, lay stiff, refused food, and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Zaimu died for integrity he dressed formally, kowtowed north, lay down, refused food, and died.

sentences.zh: 文蔚，字子貞，蒙古人。

translations.literal: Wenwei, style name Zizhen, was a Mongol.
translations.idiomatic: Wenwei, styled Zizhen, was a Mongol.

sentences.zh: 同治初，從將軍都興阿軍，累擢佐領。

translations.literal: In early Tongzhi he followed General Duxing'a's army and rose repeatedly to company commander.
translations.idiomatic: In early Tongzhi he followed General Duxing'a and rose to company commander.

sentences.zh: 變作，家人勸出避，誓死不應。

translations.literal: When the revolt broke out his family urged him to flee; he vowed to die and would not.
translations.idiomatic: When revolt broke out family urged flight; he vowed to die.

sentences.zh: 一夕，痛飲，哭不止，家人謂其醉也，中夜遽卒，蓋陰以毒物自戕矣，年八十。

translations.literal: One night he drank heavily and wept without cease; family thought him drunk; at midnight he died suddenly — he had secretly taken poison — aged eighty.
translations.idiomatic: One night he drank and wept; at midnight he died — secretly poisoned — aged eighty.

sentences.zh: 協領佘世寬，驍騎校恩厚、同源，佐領春濤、延熙，防禦貴慶、延福，前鋒錦章、炳炎，領催東皋、德慶、延昌、松廷、三元、錫昌，雲騎尉良，師範學校校長崇樸，生員崇椿，同以絕食死。

translations.literal: Battalion commander She Shikuan, brave-rider commandants Enhou and Tongyuan, company commanders Chuntao and Yanxi, garrison defense officers Guiqing and Yanfu, vanguards Jinzhang and Bingyan, levy chiefs Donggao, Deqing, Yanchang, Songting, Sanyuan, and Xichang, cloud-rider commandant Liang, normal-school principal Chongpu, and student Chongchun all starved themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: Many officers including She Shikuan, Enhou, Chongpu, and Chongchun starved themselves.

sentences.zh: 防禦吉瑞嘔血死。

translations.literal: Garrison defense Jirui died vomiting blood.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison defense Jirui died vomiting blood.

sentences.zh: 領催德霈自經死。

translations.literal: Levy chief Depei hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Levy chief Depei hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 前鋒鍾祥、達邦，領催慶耀、升奎、國能、殿倫、發昆，五品頂戴發元，生員穆都哩，同自經死。

translations.literal: Vanguards Zhongxiang and Dabang, levy chiefs Qingyao, Shengkui, Guoneng, Dianlun, and Fakun, fifth-rank wearer Fayuan, and student Mudouli all hanged themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxiang, Dabang, many levy chiefs, Fayuan, and Mudouli hanged themselves.

sentences.zh: 前鋒德尚，領催清泰，投江死。

translations.literal: Vanguard Deshang and levy chief Qingtai threw themselves in the river.
translations.idiomatic: Vanguard Deshang and levy chief Qingtai drowned themselves.

sentences.zh: 舉人恩沛，吞玻璃死。

translations.literal: Graduate Enpei swallowed glass and died.
translations.idiomatic: Graduate Enpei swallowed glass and died.

sentences.zh: 佐領榮康、德興、普亮，前鋒國棟、和庸及弟啟瑞，領催文光、延熙及弟延本、海春，恩騎尉延章、西登布，武舉人炳南，生員喜德，師範畢業生錫蕃，均受傷死。

translations.literal: Company commanders Rongkang, Dexing, and Puliang, vanguards Guodong, Heyong, brother Qirui, levy chiefs Wenguang, Yanxi, brother Yanben, Haichun, grace-rider commandants Yanzhang and Xidengbu, military graduate Bingnan, student Xide, and normal-school graduate Xifan all died of wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Rongkang, Dexing, Guodong, and many others died of wounds.

sentences.zh: 安徽縣丞壽餘及二子德興、德祚，同日遇害。

translations.literal: Anhui county assistant Shouyu and his two sons Dexing and Dezuo were killed on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui assistant Shouyu and sons Dexing and Dezuo were killed the same day.

sentences.zh: 其被調江寧者，排長國權、海靖、文馨、啟貞，與桂城同日死。

translations.literal: Those transferred to Jiangning — platoon leaders Guoquan, Haijing, Wenxin, and Qizhen — died the same day as Guicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Platoon leaders Guoquan, Haijing, Wenxin, and Qizhen, transferred to Jiangning, died with Guicheng.

sentences.zh: 排長炳升，守北城戰死。

translations.literal: Platoon leader Bingsheng died defending the north wall in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Platoon leader Bingsheng died defending the north wall.

sentences.zh: 馬兵那康元，遇敵軍南門，搜軍械，不服，縛於樹，支解死。

translations.literal: Cavalryman Nakangyuan met enemy troops at the south gate searching for arms; he would not submit; they bound him to a tree and dismembered him to death.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalryman Nakangyuan at the south gate refused a arms search, was bound to a tree, and dismembered.

sentences.zh: 高謙，字敬亭，湖南沅江人。

translations.literal: Gao Qian, style name Jingting, was a native of Yuanjiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qian, styled Jingting, came from Yuanjiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 同治季年，從左宗棠度隴司書記，以勞保縣丞，發安徽。

translations.literal: In the last years of Tongzhi he followed Zuo Zongtang crossing Longyou as staff secretary; by merit he was recommended for county assistant and dispatched to Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In late Tongzhi he followed Zuo Zongtang west as secretary and was recommended for Anhui county assistant.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年，宗棠督兩江，委謙淮北督銷分局，連任十有七年，鹽商饋遺皆不受；

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu Zongtang governed the two Jiangs and assigned Qian to the Huaibei salt sales sub-bureau; he held the post for seventeen years and accepted no gifts from salt merchants;
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8 Zongtang assigned him to Huaibei salt sales for seventeen years, accepting no merchant gifts;

sentences.zh: 受代，典衣裘而行：商民頌之。

translations.literal: on handing over his post he pawned his fur coat to travel — merchants and people praised him.
translations.idiomatic: on leaving he pawned his furs to travel — merchants praised him.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，補安徽阜陽縣丞，清嚴不妄入民間一錢，知縣有過舉，輒陰為規正，民尤愛戴之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was appointed Fuyang county assistant in Anhui, stern and incorruptible, not taking a single cash from the people wrongly; when the magistrate erred he secretly corrected him — the people especially loved him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he became Fuyang assistant, incorruptible; when the magistrate erred he quietly corrected him and won deep affection.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年九月二十五日，安慶變作，變兵旋入阜陽，左右勸謙引避，厲聲斥曰：「名位雖卑，大節不易，吾豈苟活者耶？

translations.literal: On the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month of the third year of Xuantong Anqing revolted; mutineers soon entered Fuyang; attendants urged Qian to flee; he rebuked them loudly, saying, "Though my rank is low, great integrity does not change — am I one to live in cowardice?
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fifth of the ninth month of Xuantong 3 Anqing rose; mutineers entered Fuyang; attendants urged flight; he rebuked them: "Rank may be low but integrity does not — am I to live in shame?

sentences.zh: 」即夕飲鴆自盡。

translations.literal: " That evening he drank poison and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: " That evening he took poison.

sentences.zh: 凌晨家人入視，則衣冠端坐，氣絕，面如生，年七十有四。

translations.literal: At dawn when family entered to see him he sat in full dress, breath gone, face as in life, aged seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn family found him seated in full dress, dead, face peaceful, aged seventy-four.

sentences.zh: 民聞之，皆走哭，議立祠祀之，因亂未果。

translations.literal: When the people heard they all ran to weep; they planned to erect a shrine but because of disorder it was not done.
translations.idiomatic: People ran to weep and planned a shrine, but disorder prevented it.

sentences.zh: 黃為熊，字子祥，江西德化人。

translations.literal: Huang Weixiong, style name Zixiang, was a native of Dehua in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Weixiong, styled Zixiang, came from Dehua in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 由舉人挑知縣，發浙江，署於潛，再署東陽。

translations.literal: By provincial graduate he was selected for magistrate, dispatched to Zhejiang, acted in Yuqian, and again in Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate, he was posted to Zhejiang, acting in Yuqian and Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 民好訟，積案千百，排日決事，民畏而感之。

translations.literal: The people were fond of litigation; backlog cases numbered in the thousands; he set days to decide matters; the people feared and were grateful.
translations.idiomatic: Litigation was rife with thousands of backlog cases; he set days to judge; people feared and thanked him.

sentences.zh: 署蘭溪，除盜匪殆盡，益興學重農。

translations.literal: Acting in Lanxi he nearly eliminated bandits and further promoted learning and valued agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: In Lanxi he nearly wiped out bandits and promoted learning and agriculture.

sentences.zh: 治行上聞，被獎。

translations.literal: His governance was reported upward and he was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: His record was reported upward and he was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 省城變作，聞之欲自裁，翌日，聞訛言謂京師陷，大慟曰：「主憂臣辱，主辱臣死，何顏見地方人民耶？

translations.literal: When the provincial capital revolted, on hearing it he wished to kill himself; the next day hearing false reports that the capital had fallen he grieved greatly and said, "When the ruler grieves the minister is shamed; when the ruler is shamed the minister dies — what face to show the local people?
translations.idiomatic: When the capital rose he wished to die; next day false word of Beijing's fall made him say, "Ruler grieved, minister shamed — what face to show the people?

sentences.zh: 」亂民來奪縣印，正色諭之，不許，抱印自經。

translations.literal: " Rioters came to seize the county seal; he instructed them sternly and would not yield; he embraced the seal and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: " Rioters seized the seal; he rebuked them, refused, embraced the seal, and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 僚友趨救，氣已絕，面如生。

translations.literal: Colleagues rushed to save him; breath was already gone; his face was as in life.
translations.idiomatic: Colleagues came too late; he was dead, face peaceful.

sentences.zh: 文海，字云舫，漢軍鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Hai, style name Yunfang, was a Hanjun of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Hai, styled Yunfang, was a Bordered Blue Banner Hanjun.

sentences.zh: 由拔貢生用知縣，發浙江，一攝長興，充勸業道科長。

translations.literal: From selected tribute student he was appointed magistrate, dispatched to Zhejiang, once acted in Changxing, and served as section chief of the encouragement-of-industry circuit.
translations.idiomatic: A tribute student, he was posted to Zhejiang, acted in Changxing, and headed an industry section.

sentences.zh: 新軍變，入寓搜軍械，得洋槍，將縶之，文海發槍，斃一人，傷二人，出報其黨，被收，慷慨不屈，引頸受刃死。

translations.literal: When the new army mutinied they entered his lodging searching for arms, found a foreign gun, and were about to seize him; Wen Hai fired, killed one man, wounded two, went out to report to his party, was taken, generous and unyielding, offered his neck and died by the blade.
translations.idiomatic: New-army mutineers found a foreign gun in his lodging; he shot one dead, wounded two, was seized, refused to yield, and died by the blade.

sentences.zh: 趙翰階，字春亭，山西祁縣人。

translations.literal: Zhao Hanjie, style name Chunting, was a native of Qi County in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hanjie, styled Chunting, came from Qi in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 父受璧，奉天昌圖知府，有惠政。

translations.literal: His father Shoubi was Changtu prefect in Fengtian and had benevolent policies.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shoubi was Changtu prefect in Fengtian and governed benevolently.

sentences.zh: 翰階隨侍邊塞，習騎射，以任俠重鄉里。

translations.literal: Hanji followed him on the frontier, learned riding and archery, and was valued in his district for chivalry.
translations.idiomatic: He followed his father on the frontier, learned riding and archery, and was famed for chivalry.

sentences.zh: 拳匪之變，嘗乘垣斃其酋。

translations.literal: In the Boxer turmoil he once scaled a wall and killed a chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the Boxer turmoil he once scaled a wall and killed a chief.

sentences.zh: 增韞素與習，官浙江巡撫，令充衛隊管帶。

translations.literal: Zeng Yun had long known him; as Zhejiang governor he appointed him commander of the guard battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zeng Yun, knowing him, made him guard battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 杭垣變作，撫署被圍，率猶子趙錦標等突圍入護巡撫家屬，穴牆匿民舍。

translations.literal: When Hangzhou revolted the governor's yamen was besieged; he led his nephew Zhao Jinbiao and others to break out and enter to protect the governor's family, burrowing through a wall to hide in a civilian house.
translations.idiomatic: When Hangzhou rose he broke into the besieged yamen with nephew Jinbiao to protect the governor's family, hiding in a civilian house.

sentences.zh: 明日，聞巡撫為新軍所拘，往救之，挈錦標持手槍出，為變兵所執，曰：「我北方男子，豈畏死者！

translations.literal: The next day, hearing the governor was detained by the new army, he went to rescue him; taking Jinbiao he came out with pistols and was seized by mutineers.
translations.idiomatic: Next day hearing the governor was held, he went to rescue with Jinbiao and pistols and was seized.

sentences.zh: 」遂與錦標同被害。

translations.literal: He said, "I am a northern man — would I fear death!" He and Jinbiao were killed together.
translations.idiomatic: He said, "I am a northern man — do I fear death?" He and Jinbiao were killed together.

sentences.zh: 貴林，字翰香，滿洲正紅旗人，杭州駐防。

translations.literal: Guilin, style name Hanxiang, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner, garrisoned at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin, styled Hanxiang, was a Plain Red Banner Manchu at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 官協領，與浙人士遊，有賢名。

translations.literal: Battalion commander; he associated with Zhejiang scholars and had a reputation for worth.
translations.idiomatic: A battalion commander, he associated with Zhejiang scholars and was known for worth.

sentences.zh: 浙兵變，駐防營猶抗拒，相持二日。

translations.literal: When Zhejiang troops mutinied the garrison camp still resisted for two days.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhejiang mutinied the garrison resisted two days.

sentences.zh: 浙人勸罷戰，招貴林出營議事垂定，有陷之者，謂旗營反覆不可信，且誣貴林署毒各坊巷井中，變軍誘之出，槍斃之。

translations.literal: Zhejiang people urged an end to fighting and summoned Guilin out to discuss terms nearly settled; someone framed him, saying the banner camp was treacherous and untrustworthy, and also falsely accused Guilin of poisoning wells in every lane; mutineers lured him out and shot him dead.
translations.idiomatic: Locals urged peace and summoned Guilin to negotiate; he was framed as poisoning wells; mutineers lured him out and shot him.

sentences.zh: 同出者，子量海，舉人存炳，佐領哈楚顯，同被戕。

translations.literal: Those who went out with him — his son Lianghai, graduate Cunbing, and company commander Hachuxian — were also killed.
translations.idiomatic: His son Lianghai, graduate Cunbing, and company commander Hachuxian were also killed.

sentences.zh: 額特精額，字蔚如，杭營正紅旗防禦，駐守武林門。

translations.literal: Etejing'e, style name Weiru, was Hangzhou garrison defense officer of the Plain Red Banner, stationed at Wulin Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Etejing'e, styled Weiru, was Plain Red Banner garrison defense at Wulin Gate.

sentences.zh: 辛亥九月十四夜，變兵強令開城，額特精額喝問：「何人？

translations.literal: On the night of the fourteenth day of the ninth month of 1911 mutineers forced the gate open; Etejing'e shouted, "Who goes there?
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the fourteenth of the ninth month mutineers forced the gate; he shouted, "Who goes there?

sentences.zh: 」以「革命黨」對，遂斥曰：「汝等狗也！

translations.literal: They answered "revolutionary party"; he then rebuked them, "You are dogs!
translations.idiomatic: They said "revolutionaries"; he cried, "You are dogs!

sentences.zh: 我不死，城不能開。

translations.literal: " If I do not die the gate cannot open.
translations.idiomatic: " While I live the gate will not open.

sentences.zh: 」獨持槍擊眾，眾環攻，慘剁死，暴屍數日，居近商民始殮之。

translations.literal: " Alone he held his gun and fired at the crowd; the crowd surrounded and hacked him to a cruel death; his corpse lay exposed for days before nearby merchants coffined him.
translations.idiomatic: " He fired alone; the mob surrounded and hacked him; his body lay exposed days before merchants buried him.

sentences.zh: 文榮，字如山，蒙古巴岳特氏。

translations.literal: Wenrong, style name Rushan, was of the Mongol Bayute clan.
translations.idiomatic: Wenrong, styled Rushan, was of the Mongol Bayute clan.

sentences.zh: 世襲雲騎尉。

translations.literal: Hereditary cloud-rider commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary cloud-rider commandant.

sentences.zh: 變兵攻旗營三日，堅不下，使來議和，合營官兵原效死力爭，將軍德濟遽遣貴林出許之，官兵皆擲槍軍署，痛哭散去。

translations.literal: Mutineers attacked the banner camp three days without taking it; they sent envoys to discuss peace; the whole camp's officers and soldiers were ready to fight to the death; General Deji hastily sent Guilin out to agree; officers and soldiers all threw down guns at the military office and dispersed weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Mutineers besieged the banner camp three days; General Deji sent Guilin to agree peace; troops threw down guns and wept away.

sentences.zh: 文榮憤不欲生，手書十六字曰：「杭營失守，忠義掃地。

translations.literal: Wenrong in fury did not wish to live and wrote sixteen characters by hand: "Hangzhou garrison lost — loyalty and righteousness swept clean.
translations.idiomatic: Wenrong, unwilling to live, wrote: "Hangzhou garrison lost — loyalty swept clean.

sentences.zh: 清流北向，是吾死所！

translations.literal: Clear stream flows north — there is my place to die!
translations.idiomatic: Clear stream flows north — there I shall die!

sentences.zh: 」遂投河死。

translations.literal: " He then threw himself in the river and died.
translations.idiomatic: " He threw himself in the river.

sentences.zh: 迎喜，號壽芝，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Yingxi, sobriquet Shouzhi, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yingxi, known as Shouzhi, was a Bordered White Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 年八十餘矣，當議和時，詣軍署以死爭，大呼曰：「八旗受國恩三百年，今事至此，若輩猶欲靦顏偷生乎？

translations.literal: Over eighty years old, when peace was discussed he went to the military office to argue with death, crying loudly, "The Eight Banners received the state's grace three hundred years — now matters come to this — do you still wish to live shamefaced?
translations.idiomatic: Past eighty, when peace was discussed he went to the military office crying, "The Eight Banners received three hundred years of grace — will you still live in shame?

sentences.zh: 」遂歸，閉戶自經死。

translations.literal: " He returned, closed his door, and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: " He returned home and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 金海，正藍旗前鋒校。

translations.literal: Jinhai was a vanguard commandant of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jinhai was a Plain Blue Banner vanguard commandant.

sentences.zh: 變兵架巨砲吳山，遙轟旗營，眾議啟城馳奪之，金海原從戰，聞議和，遂棄械於河，亦自經死。

translations.literal: Mutineers mounted heavy guns on Wu Hill and shelled the banner camp from afar; the crowd proposed opening the gate to seize them; Jinhai had wished to fight; hearing of peace he threw his arms in the river and also hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Mutineers shelled the camp from Wu Hill; Jinhai had wished to fight; on peace he threw his arms in the river and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 希曾，正藍旗監生，前南昌知府盛元孫。

translations.literal: Xizeng was a Plain Blue Banner student, grandson of former Nanchang prefect Sheng Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Xizeng was a Plain Blue Banner student, grandson of former Nanchang prefect Sheng Yuan.

sentences.zh: 變兵入營多劫殺，希曾斥之曰：「既議和矣，奈何猶為盜賊行？

translations.literal: Mutineers entering the camp robbed and killed many; Xizeng rebuked them, saying, "Since peace is agreed, why still act as bandits?
translations.idiomatic: Mutineers looted the camp; Xizeng rebuked them: "Peace is agreed — why still act as bandits?

sentences.zh: 」眾怒，擊，竟剁屍如泥。

translations.literal: " The crowd in anger struck him and hacked his corpse to mud.
translations.idiomatic: " The mob hacked him to pieces.

sentences.zh: 時旗人皆自危，頗有無故被殺者，其姓名不能盡詳矣。

translations.literal: At the time banner people were all in peril; many were killed without cause — their names cannot all be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Banner people were in peril; many were killed without cause — names cannot all be recorded.

sentences.zh: 玉潤，漢軍鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: Yurun was a Hanjun of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yurun was a Bordered Red Banner Hanjun.

sentences.zh: 光緒季年，以鑾儀衛治儀正出補秦州營游擊。

translations.literal: In the last years of Guangxu, as director of ceremonies in the Imperial Bodyguard he went out and was appointed Qinzhou battalion vice-commander.
translations.idiomatic: In late Guangxu he left the Imperial Bodyguard and became Qinzhou battalion vice-commander.

sentences.zh: 武昌事起，甘肅僻遠，總督長庚素持鎮靜，聞陝西擾亂，乃戒嚴。

translations.literal: When Wuchang rose Gansu was remote; Governor Chang Geng had always been calm; hearing Shaanxi disturbed, he declared martial law.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuchang rose remote Gansu stayed calm until Shaanxi stirred and martial law was declared.

sentences.zh: 時有道員黃越者，宿與南方黨人通，充軍事參議，欲通陝中民軍謀獨立。

translations.literal: At the time Intendant Huang Yue, who had long communicated with southern party men, served as military adviser and wished to connect with Shaanxi revolutionary troops to seek independence.
translations.idiomatic: Intendant Huang Yue, long tied to southern revolutionaries, sought Shaanxi ties for independence.

sentences.zh: 以陝中民軍屢敗，乃陰引川軍入甘為援。

translations.literal: As Shaanxi revolutionary troops were repeatedly defeated he secretly brought Sichuan troops into Gansu as aid.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaanxi revolutionaries failed he secretly brought Sichuan troops into Gansu.

sentences.zh: 玉潤偵知，日與守備習斌籌守禦，以限於兵額，末由增募。

translations.literal: Yurun detected this and daily with garrison commandant Xi Bin planned defense, but limited by troop quotas could not raise more.
translations.idiomatic: Yurun detected this and with commandant Xi Bin planned defense but could not raise more troops.

sentences.zh: 是時南北款議成，甘、陝電斷不相聞。

translations.literal: At the time north-south peace talks succeeded; Gansu and Shaanxi lost telegraph contact with each other.
translations.idiomatic: North-south peace talks succeeded; Gansu and Shaanxi lost telegraph contact.

sentences.zh: 越於秦州各官獨憚玉潤忠鯁，壬子正月二十三日，遂率眾入城據各署局，而以兵圍游擊署。

translations.literal: Among Qinzhou officials Yue alone feared Yurun's loyalty and sternness; on the twenty-third day of the first month of 1912 he led a crowd into the city to seize every office and bureau and surrounded the vice-commander's yamen with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yue feared Yurun's loyalty; on the twenty-third of the first month of 1912 he seized Qinzhou offices and besieged the vice-commander's yamen.

sentences.zh: 玉潤列隊出拒，身自督戰，終以兵少不敵，玉潤中槍，殞於陣。

translations.literal: Yurun formed ranks to resist, personally directed the battle, but in the end was outnumbered; Yurun was shot and fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Yurun formed ranks and fought in person but was outnumbered and shot dead.

sentences.zh: 勞謙光，字佩蘭，山東陽信人。

translations.literal: Lao Qian, style name Peilan, was a native of Yangxin in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Qian, styled Peilan, came from Yangxin in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 少讀書，有用世志。

translations.literal: In youth he read books and had the will to serve the age.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he read and wished to serve the age.

sentences.zh: 入北洋武備學堂，畢業，山西設武備學堂，聘為教習，管帶馬隊營，捐知縣，遂官於晉。

translations.literal: He entered the Beiyang military academy, graduated, was hired as instructor when Shanxi established its military academy, commanded a cavalry battalion, purchased magistrate, and served in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He graduated Beiyang academy, taught at Shanxi's academy, commanded cavalry, purchased magistrate, and served in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 新政創始，若督練處、警察學堂並充提調官。

translations.literal: When new policies began he concurrently headed the training office and police academy.
translations.idiomatic: Under new policies he headed training and police academies.

sentences.zh: 數歲，移充北洋常備軍第三鎮參謀官，兼軍需官，擢第六鎮工程管帶官。

translations.literal: Several years later he transferred to Beiyang regular army third division staff officer and concurrently supply officer, then rose to sixth division engineering battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: He later became third division staff and supply officer, then sixth division engineering commander.

sentences.zh: 武漢變起，率工程營赴前敵，築橋漢上，將以濟師，敵爭之力，砲子雨下，躬督視不卻，猝中砲死，時十月初六日。

translations.literal: When Wuhan rose he led the engineering battalion to the front, built bridges on the Han, intending to ferry troops; the enemy contested fiercely; shells fell like rain; he personally directed without retreat and was suddenly killed by shellfire on the sixth day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuhan rose he led engineers to bridge the Han; under shellfire he directed personally and was killed on the sixth of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 死而橋卒成，清師得渡，得漢陽，清廷主兵者遂有停戰之議。

translations.literal: After his death the bridge was completed; Qing troops crossed and took Hanyang; Qing military leaders then discussed ceasefire.
translations.idiomatic: After his death the bridge was finished; Qing forces crossed, took Hanyang, and ceasefire followed.

sentences.zh: 吉升，字允中，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Jisheng, style name Yunzhong, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Jisheng, styled Yunzhong, was a Bordered Yellow Banner Manchu.

sentences.zh: 以學生官本旗前鋒，入海軍學習，積資充海籌兵艦幫帶官。

translations.literal: From student he held his banner vanguard and entered naval study, rising to deputy commander of the cruiser Haichou.
translations.idiomatic: From student to banner vanguard he entered naval service and became deputy commander of the cruiser Haichou.

sentences.zh: 湖北告警，海軍奉調赴援，至者兵艦十五艘、魚雷艇二艘。

translations.literal: When Hubei sounded the alarm the navy was ordered to aid; fifteen warships and two torpedo boats arrived.
translations.idiomatic: When Hubei alarmed the navy sent fifteen warships and two torpedo boats.

sentences.zh: 清軍攻漢陽，海軍助勢，而砲發多不命中。

translations.literal: Qing troops attacked Hanyang; the navy aided; many shells missed.
translations.idiomatic: Qing forces attacked Hanyang with naval support but many shots missed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，言煤罄，相率下駛。

translations.literal: Before long they said coal was exhausted and left downstream together.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they claimed coal was out and sailed downstream together.

sentences.zh: 九月二十一日，海籌與海容、海琛三巡洋艦奉令離漢口，二十三日抵九江。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the ninth month Haichou with cruisers Hairong and Haichen were ordered to leave Hankou; on the twenty-third they reached Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first of the ninth month Haichou with Hairong and Haichen left Hankou and reached Jiujiang on the twenty-third.

sentences.zh: 時江西九江已響應武昌，海容、海琛遂相約懸白旗，停泊。

translations.literal: Jiujiang in Jiangxi had already responded to Wuchang; Hairong and Haichen then agreed to fly white flags and anchor.
translations.idiomatic: Jiujiang had joined Wuchang; Hairong and Haichen flew white flags and anchored.

sentences.zh: 海籌管帶喜昌不欲，邀吉升同遁，吉升★M4然涕下，曰：「國家經營海軍四十年，結果乃如是耶？

translations.literal: Haichou commander Xichang did not wish to; he invited Jisheng to flee together; Jisheng with tears streaming said, "The state labored forty years to build a navy — the result is only this?
translations.idiomatic: Commander Xichang refused; inviting Jisheng to flee, Jisheng wept, "Forty years building a navy — and this is the result?

sentences.zh: 」發憤投長江死。

translations.literal: " In fury he threw himself in the Yangzi and died.
translations.idiomatic: " He threw himself in the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 張程九，字子澐，奉天台安人。

translations.literal: Zhang Chuankai, style name Ziyun, was a native of Tai'an in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chuankai, styled Ziyun, came from Tai'an in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 由歲貢考充盛京宗室學教習，任滿，以知縣用。

translations.literal: From senior tribute he passed examination as instructor of the Mukden imperial clan school; when his term ended he was appointed magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: From senior tribute he taught at the Mukden clan school, then became magistrate.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，選為奉天諮議局議員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong he was selected as Fengtian advisory council member.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 he joined the Fengtian advisory council.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，鄂變起，地方不逞之徒，假改革名義，狡然思逞，台安齊某糾眾將起事，憚程九持正不敢發。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year when Hubei rose local ruffians under the name of reform plotted boldly; Qi of Tai'an gathered a crowd to rise but feared Chuankai's uprightness and did not dare act.
translations.idiomatic: When Hubei rose local plotters feared Chuankai's integrity and held back.

sentences.zh: 程九聞警，至省謁總督趙爾巽，請派隊剿辦，免塗炭地方，爾巽允其請，並令回縣辦鄉團以資捍衛。

translations.literal: Chuankai heard the alarm, went to the provincial capital to visit Governor Zhao Erxun, asked to send troops to suppress and spare the region slaughter; Erxun agreed and also ordered him home to organize local militia for defense.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Governor Zhao Erxun, asked for troops to suppress revolt, and was sent home to organize militia.

sentences.zh: 程九歸，經縣西佛牛錄，為群賊所伺，設伏遇害。

translations.literal: Returning, passing Foxian west of the county, bandits lay in ambush and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Returning through Foxian he was ambushed and killed.

sentences.zh: 卹贈知府，賞世職。

translations.literal: Posthumous gifts made him acting prefect and granted hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made acting prefect with hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 王文域，字伯若，四川人。

translations.literal: Wang Wencheng, style name Boruo, was a Sichuan native.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wencheng, styled Boruo, was from Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 知山東樂安縣，辛亥冬，為變兵所戕；

translations.literal: Magistrate of Le'an in Shandong; in the winter of 1911 he was killed by mutineers;
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate of Le'an, Shandong, killed by mutineers in the winter of 1911;

sentences.zh: 黑龍江海倫府巡防馬隊管帶官譚鳳亭，於十月陣亡：有旨優恤。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang Hailun patrol cavalry commander Tan Fengting fell in battle in the tenth month: an edict granted favorable condolence.
translations.idiomatic: Hailun patrol commander Tan Fengting fell in the tenth month with imperial condolence.

sentences.zh: 伊犁將軍志銳被戕，僕呂順以樸誠著，臨難護主，同死之。

translations.literal: Ili General Zhirui was killed; servant Lv Shun was known for plain loyalty; in crisis he protected his master and died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Ili General Zhirui was killed; servant Lv Shun, famed for loyalty, died protecting him.

sentences.zh: 從死者，武巡捕官劉從德，四川人；

translations.literal: Those who died with him: armed patrol officer Liu Congde, a Sichuan native;
translations.idiomatic: Those who died with him: patrol officer Liu Congde of Sichuan;

sentences.zh: 教練官春勳，京旗人。

translations.literal: drill officer Chunxun, a Beijing-banner man.
translations.idiomatic: drill officer Chunxun, a Beijing-banner man.

sentences.zh: 志銳自有傳。

translations.literal: Zhirui has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Zhirui has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 張傳楷，字睿斌，直隸青縣諸生。

translations.literal: Zhang Chengjiu, style name Ruibin, was a licentiate of Qing County in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chengjiu, styled Ruibin, was a licentiate of Qing County, Zhili.

sentences.zh: 充宗人府供事，敘勞得知州。

translations.literal: He served as clerk in the Imperial Clan Court and by merit rose to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He served the Imperial Clan Court and rose by merit to prefect.

sentences.zh: 革命軍起，舉朝震恐，自親貴達官而下，惟日以徙家入外人居留地為事。

translations.literal: When the revolutionary army rose the whole court was terrified; from imperial kin and high officials down, each day's business was moving families into foreign concessions.
translations.idiomatic: When revolution rose the court panicked; nobles and officials fled into foreign concessions.

sentences.zh: 傳楷憤甚，詣都察院上說帖，請代奏，院官無在者，止院門，哭三日，無一官至。

translations.literal: Chengjiu was greatly angered; he went to the Censorate with a petition asking them to memorialize for him; no censor was present; he stopped at the gate and wept three days — not one official came.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, he petitioned the Censorate to memorialize; no censor came; he wept at the gate three days.

sentences.zh: 遜位詔下，拔所佩刀自戕死。

translations.literal: When the abdication edict came down he drew the blade at his belt and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: When abdication was announced he killed himself with his sword.

sentences.zh: 自銘十六字曰：「成仁取義，孔、孟所垂。

translations.literal: He inscribed sixteen characters for himself: "To achieve humanity and take righteousness — Confucius and Mencius handed this down.
translations.idiomatic: He left sixteen characters: "Achieving humanity and taking righteousness — Confucius and Mencius handed this down.

sentences.zh: 讀書明理，捨此何為！

translations.literal: Read books and understand principle — apart from this what is there to do!
translations.idiomatic: Read books, understand principle — apart from this what is there to do!

sentences.zh: 孫文楷，字模卿，山東益都人。
